cards.name: Adaptive Plumage
cards.text:
Hero Action (thwart): If you are Angel, remove 3 threat from a scheme and confuse an enemy.
Hero Action (attack): If you are Archangel, deal 4 damage to an enemy and stun it.

cards.name: Aerial Agility
cards.text:
Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy attacks, if you are:
• Angel, ignore each boost icon (BOOST) and each "Boost" ability for this attack.
• Archangel, give your hero a tough status card and gain retaliate 1 for this attack.

cards.name: Aerial Intervention
cards.text: Interrupt: When a character would take any amount of damage from an attack, exhaust an [[AERIAL]] character you control → prevent up to 3 of that damage.

cards.name: Angel
cards.text: Angel of Life — Response: After you play an [[AERIAL]] event, draw 1 card. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "I never feel freer than when I'm flying!"

cards.name: Angel's Aerie
cards.text:
Response: After you defend against an attack, place 1 fatigue counter here.
Alter-Ego Action: Remove each fatigue counter from here → heal 1 damage from your identity for each fatigue counter removed this way.

cards.name: Archangel
cards.text: Angel of Death — Response: After you play an [[AERIAL]] event, deal damage to an enemy equal to that event's printed cost. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Avian Anatomy
cards.text: Response: After you spend this card to pay for an [[AERIAL]] event, return that event to your hand after resolving its effects.

cards.name: Bombs Away
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust an [[AERIAL]] character you control and choose a player → deal 3 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player.

cards.name: Cannonball
cards.text: Interrupt: When Cannonball would take any amount of consequential damage, reduce that amount by X, where X is the number of [[AERIAL]] cards in your hand.
cards.flavor: "Best get outta my way when Ah'm blastin'!"

cards.name: Containment Strategy
cards.text:
Attach to a non-permanent side scheme. Max 1 per side scheme.
Response: After a hero defends against an attack, remove 1 threat from attached scheme (2 threat instead if that hero took no damage from that attack).

cards.name: Elixir
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait.
STAR Response: After Elixir attacks or thwarts, heal 1 damage from another friendly character.

cards.name: Ever Vigilant
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [AERIAL] trait.
Hero Action: Ready your hero and remove 2 threat from the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "I do everything like a hawk." —Archangel

cards.name: Eyes in the Sky
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you reveal a non-[[ELITE]] minion, exhaust an [[AERIAL]] character you control and discard this card → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. Then, reveal another card from the encounter deck.

cards.name: Flying Formation
cards.text:
Alliance. (The players can pay this card's costs as a group.)
Hero Action: Ready up to 3 [[AERIAL]] characters.
cards.flavor: "Bobby, form up on me!" —Archangel

cards.name: Metamorphosis
cards.text:
Action: Change form. Then, if you are:
• Warren Worthington III, draw 1 card.
• Angel, remove 2 threat from a scheme.
• Archangel, deal 3 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Natural Flight
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. If you are Angel, this thwart ignores the crisis icon (CRISIS) and the patrol keyword.
cards.flavor: "Just relax and enjoy the flight." —Angel

cards.name: Psylocke
cards.text:
STAR Hero Response: After Psylocke attacks, if you are:
• Angel, heal 1 damage from Psylocke.
• Archangel, ready your hero.

cards.name: Razor Dive
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If you are Archangel, this attack gains overkill and piercing.
cards.flavor: Apocalypse replaced Angel's natural wings with razor-sharp, techno-organic ones.

cards.name: Render Medical Aid
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player heals a total of 5 damage from among characters they control.
cards.flavor: "Get the critical cases back to the mansion for treatment." —Beast

cards.name: Siryn
cards.text: STAR Response: After Siryn attacks, stun a minion.
cards.flavor: "EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!"

cards.name: Soaring Acrobatics
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Hero Interrupt: When an [[AERIAL]] character you control uses a basic power, exhaust Soaring Acrobatics → that character gets +1 to that power for this use.

cards.name: Soaring Hearts
cards.text:
Team-Up (Angel and Psylocke). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action: Search your discard pile for an identity-specific event and add it to your hand. Ready Angel and Psylocke.

cards.name: Taunt
cards.text: Hero Action: The villain attacks you. Other characters cannot defend against this attack. Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "Hey! Fido! Who let you off your leash?" —Jubilee

cards.name: Techno-Organic Wings
cards.text:
Hero Action: Exhaust Techno-Organic Wings → if you are:
• Angel, ready your hero.
• Archangel, reduce the cost of the next [[AERIAL]] event card you play from your hand this phase by 2.

cards.name: The Power of Flight
cards.text: Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for an [[AERIAL]] card.

cards.name: Warpath
cards.text:
Toughness.
Hero Response: After Warpath defends against an attack, play an event with a "Hero Action" ability from your hand (paying its cost).

cards.name: Warren Worthington III
cards.text: Regrowth — Action: Heal 1 damage from Warren Worthington III. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I have to keep my wings bound—to hide who I am—to live in this society."

cards.name: Worthington Industries
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Worthington Industries → shuffle 1 [[AERIAL]] card from your discard pile into your deck. If you are in alter-ego form, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: As CEO, Warren has the vast resources of the family-owned Worthington Industries at his disposal.

cards.name: X-Force Recruit
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-FORCE]] trait.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[X-FORCE]] trait.

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text: Puny Pest — Response: After you change to this form, remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Why don't you pick on somebody your own size?"

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text: Giant Nuisance — Response: After you change to this form, deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh Yeah, tiny dude is big now!"

cards.name: Ant-Man
cards.text:
Ant-Man gets +1 hit point for each pym counter on him.
Interrupt: When Ant-Man enters play, place 1 pym counter on him (to a maximum of 4) for each resource you overpaid for Ant-Man's cost.

cards.name: Ant-Man's Helmet
cards.text:
Hero Response: After you change to [[Giant]] hero form, heal 2 damage from your hero.
Hero Response: After you change to [[Tiny]] hero form, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Army of Ants
cards.text: Hero Action: If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, exhaust Army of Ants → deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Antvengers Assemble!" —Scott Lang

cards.name: Assess the Situation
cards.text: Action: You get +1 hand size until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "Well, if I run, that's not cool. And if I stay and get tasered, that's not cool either. I'm in a bit of a pickle." —Tony Stark

cards.name: Call for Aid
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an [[Avenger]] ally, then add that ally to your hand.
cards.flavor: "You rang?" —Tony Stark

cards.name: Energy
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: First Aid
cards.text: Action: Heal 2 damage from any character.
cards.flavor: "Does it still qualify as first aid if it's your second day in the hospital?" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Genius
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Giant Stomp
cards.text:
Play only if you are in [[Giant]] hero form.
Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to each minion. Deal 8 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "I'd run if I were you." —Scott Lang

cards.name: Giant Strength
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change to [[Giant]] hero form, you get +1 ATK until the end of this turn.
cards.flavor: "My daughter lost her phone. I thought I'd look under these buildings." —Scott Lang

cards.name: Giant-Man
cards.text: Giant-Man gets +2 ATK while he has 3 or more remaining hit points.
cards.flavor: "Size isn't everything. Unless you're stepping over a bridge."

cards.name: Hive Mind
cards.text:
Play only if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.
Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each Army of Ants support you control.

cards.name: Lay Down the Law
cards.text: Hero Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead if you paid for this card using a MENTAL resource).
cards.flavor: "Maybe this will teach you!" —Captain America

cards.name: Moment of Triumph
cards.text: Hero Response: After you attack and defeat an enemy, heal 1 damage from your hero for each point of excess damage dealt to that enemy by that attack.

cards.name: Moxie
cards.text: Hero Response: After you change form, your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, +1 DEF until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "If you mess with one of us, you mess with all of us!" Even if I'm the last one." —Nova

cards.name: Muster Courage
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait.
Hero Action: Give up to X friendly characters a tough status card (to a maximum of 3 characters), where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

cards.name: Power Gloves
cards.text:
Attach to an [[Avenger]] ally. Max 1 per ally.
Response: After attached ally attacks or thwarts, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Pym Particles
cards.text: Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 2 damage from your hero if you are in [[Giant]] hero form or draw 1 card if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.

cards.name: Reinforced Suit
cards.text:
Attach to an ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +2 hit points.
cards.flavor: "Remember, it's not just the suit that gives you power, it's how you use it." —Hank Pym

cards.name: Resize
cards.text: Hero Action: Change to your other hero form. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "This is awesome!" —Scott Lang

cards.name: Ronin
cards.text: Ronin gets +1 THW and +1 ATK while an upgrade is attached to them.
cards.flavor: "Dunno who's wearing the suit this time, but they can definitely handle themself in a fight." —Spectrum

cards.name: Scott Lang
cards.text: Time to Unwind — Response: After you change to this form, heal 1 damage from Scott Lang.
cards.flavor: "Being Cassie's hero is all I've ever wanted."

cards.name: Stinger
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait.
Stinger does not count against your ally limit.

cards.name: Strength
cards.text: Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Swarm Tactics
cards.text:
Team-Up (Ant-Man and Wasp). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action: Change to your other hero form. Ready your hero.

cards.name: Team-Building Exercise
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Team-Building Exercise → play a card from your hand that shares a trait with your hero, reducing its resource cost by 1.

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text: Hero Response: After Wasp enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy if you are in [[Giant]] hero form or remove 2 threat from a scheme if you are in [[Tiny]] hero form.

cards.name: Wrist Gauntlets
cards.text:
Hero Action: If you are in [[Giant]] hero form, exhaust Wrist Gauntlets and spend PHYSICALPHYSICAL resources → stun an enemy.
Hero Action: If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, exhaust Wrist Gauntlets and spend ENERGYENERGY resources → confuse an enemy.

cards.name: Advanced Suit
cards.text:
Attach to an [[X-FORCE]] or [[X-MEN]] ally. Max 1 per ally.
Response: After attached ally defeats a minion or side scheme, discard 1 card from your hand → heal 1 damage from attached ally for each resource on that card.

cards.name: Basic Spell
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[MYSTIC]] trait.
Hero Action: Choose one:
• Heal 3 damage from an identity.
• Remove 3 threat from a scheme.
• Deal 3 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Bishop
cards.text: Energy Absorption — Response: After Bishop takes any amount of damage from an attack, discard an equal number of cards from the top of your deck. Add each resource card discarded this way to your hand.

cards.name: Bishop's Rifle
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Bishop's Rifle and choose an enemy → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each resource card in your hand. This attack gains ranged.

cards.name: Bishop's Uniform
cards.text: Response: After you resolve Bishop's "Energy Absorption" ability, exhaust Bishop's Uniform → heal 1 damage from Bishop for each resource card in your hand.

cards.name: Blink
cards.text: Response: After Blink enters your hand, deal 2 damage to the villain.
cards.flavor: "My name's Blink. Who do you think is faster?"

cards.name: Blood Rage
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Response: After you defeat an enemy with a basic attack, exhaust Blood Rage and take 1 damage → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Bloodgem
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[MYSTIC]] trait. Max 1 per deck.
Resource: Exhaust Bloodgem and take 2 damage → generate a WILD resource.

cards.name: Cable
cards.text: Response: After Cable thwarts and defeats a side scheme, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I know too much about what the future holds."

cards.name: Clobber
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. If this is the first card you have played this round, return this card to your hand.
cards.flavor: "It feels good to hit ninjas again." —Psylocke

cards.name: Colossus
cards.text:
Toughness.
Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, play Colossus from your hand (paying his resource cost) and declare him the defender without exhausting him.
cards.flavor: "I will always protect you, little Snowflake."

cards.name: Command Authority
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this event with a resource card, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Everyone, on me!" —Bishop

cards.name: Concussive Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this event with a resource card, ready Bishop.
cards.flavor: Bishop's power allows him to absorb energy and rechannel it into powerful blasts.

cards.name: Desperate Measures
cards.text:
Attach to an ally. Limit 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, +1 hit point, and is considered to have a wild (WILD) resource icon in addition to its printed resource icon.
cards.flavor: "My brother will never stop." —Magik

cards.name: Destiny
cards.text: Response: After Destiny enters your hand, remove 2 threat from the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Outsmarting your opponent is child's play when you know the future."

cards.name: Energy Conversion
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy attacks, shuffle each resource card in your discard pile into your deck. You cannot take more than 3 damage from this attack.

cards.name: Exorcism
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. If the top card of your deck has a MENTAL or WILD resource icon, confuse the villain.
cards.flavor: "I have purged the evil from within you." —Magik

cards.name: Full-Body Charge
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 8 damage to an enemy. If your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points, this attack gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "Coming through, tovarisch!"—Colossus

cards.name: Goldballs
cards.text: STAR Interrupt: When Goldballs attacks, discard up to 3 cards from the top of your deck → Goldballs gets +X ATK for this attack, where X is the number of cards discarded this way.
cards.flavor: "I didn't choose the name."

cards.name: Illyana Rasputin
cards.text: Interrupt: When you change to hero form, choose a [[SPELL]] in your discard pile and put it on top of your deck. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "I would sell the last piece of my soul for an egg roll right now!"

cards.name: Lead from the Front
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose a player. Each character that player controls gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "Let's go everyone!" —Carol Danvers

cards.name: Legion
cards.text:
STAR Response: After Legion uses a basic power, discard the top card of your deck. If that card's printed resource has:
ENERGY — Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
MENTAL — Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
PHYSICAL — Heal 2 damage from Legion.

cards.name: Limbo
cards.text:
Response: After the villain phase begins, exhaust Limbo → swap a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.
Action: Exhaust Limbo → swap a card in your hand with the top card of your deck.

cards.name: Lucas Bishop
cards.text: Temporally Displaced — Response: After you change to this form, add a [[TEMPORAL]] card in your discard pile to your hand.
cards.flavor: "When I journeyed to the past to save my future, this was not what I had in mind."

cards.name: Magic Barrier
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, prevent 3 damage from this attack. If the top card of your deck has a ENERGY or WILD resource icon, deal 3 damage to the attacking enemy.

cards.name: Magik
cards.text:
Play with the top card of your deck faceup.
Once per phase, you may play the top card of your deck as if it was in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "There are no snowflakes in Limbo."

cards.name: Magik's Crown
cards.text:
Magik gains steady.
While the top card of your deck has a MENTAL or WILD resource icon, Magik gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: Raised in Limbo, Magik is destined to usurp its rule from the man who brought her there.

cards.name: Malcolm
cards.text: Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → ready Malcolm. If that card has a printed PHYSICAL icon, heal 1 damage from Malcolm. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Multiple contacts. Engaging."

cards.name: Marrow
cards.text:
Play only if you have the [[X-FORCE]] or [[X-MEN]] trait.
Response: After Marrow enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "You won't look so pretty once I get you!"

cards.name: Mission Team
cards.text:
Mission Team cannot be discarded and the first player gains control of it.
Action: Exhaust Mission Team → choose:
• Reduce the cost of the next ally played to the mission this phase by 2.
• Make a mission attempt.

cards.name: Mission Team
cards.text:
Mission Team cannot be discarded and the first player gains control of it.
Action: Exhaust Mission Team → choose a player to draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Another successful mission. Hopefully this time they don't sue for damages!" —Polaris

cards.name: Morph
cards.text: Response: After Morph enters your hand, confuse the villain.
cards.flavor: "What's all the hubbub, bub?"

cards.name: Mystical Armor
cards.text:
Magik gains retaliate 1.
While the top card of your deck has a ENERGY or WILD resource icon, Magik gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: It's very fashionable in Limbo.

cards.name: Randall
cards.text: Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → ready Randall. If that card has a printed ENERGY icon, heal 1 damage from Randall. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "We're with you, boss. All the way."

cards.name: Scrying
cards.text: Action: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw one, discard one, and put one back on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Yes, I've seen your future. No, I will not tell you."—Magik

cards.name: Side-by-Side
cards.text:
Hero Action: Ready your sidekick → ready your hero and choose one:
• Heal 1 damage from both characters.
• Both characters get +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Sidekick
cards.text:
Attach to an identity-specific ally you control. Max 1 per deck.
Attached ally gets +2 hit points and is your "sidekick."
Response: After you make a basic recovery, heal 2 damage from attached ally.

cards.name: Soul Strike
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If the top card of your deck has a PHYSICAL or WILD resource icon, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Very well. Feel the bite of my Soulsword!" —Magik

cards.name: Soulsword
cards.text:
Restricted.
Magik's basic attacks gain piercing.
While the top card of your deck has a PHYSICAL or WILD resource icon, Magik gets +1 ATK.

cards.name: Spiritual Meditation
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Mystic]] trait.
Action: Draw 2 cards. Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
cards.flavor: "Every spell, every sigil, every manipulation... you must keep a close eye on everything so it doesn't backfire."

cards.name: Stepford Cuckoos
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait. Uses (3 psi counters).
Interrupt: When a player reveals a treachery, exhaust Stepford Cuckoos and remove 1 psi counter here → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. That player reveals another encounter card.

cards.name: Stepping Disc
cards.text: Hero Action: Ready your hero. Choose a Magik card in your discard pile not named Stepping Disc and put it on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: Magik's teleportation discs can take her anywhere by opening a portal through Limbo.

cards.name: Suit Up
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Search your deck and discard pile for an ally and an upgrade that can be attached to that ally. Add them to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Super-Charged
cards.text:
Action: Discard a resource card from your hand → place 1 charge counter here for each resource icon on that card.
Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, discard Super-Charged → you get +2 ATK for this attack for each charge counter here (to a maximum of +8 ATK).

cards.name: Team Training
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "We mostly just wait for Cap to yell 'Avengers Assemble' and attack in the same direction as him" —Clint Barton

cards.name: Tempus
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-MEN]] trait.
Interrupt: When the villain would scheme, discard Tempus → cancel that activation. Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card.

cards.name: Test the Defense
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Response: After you play an [[ATTACK]] event, place 1 test counter here. If there are 5 test counters here, discard this card to deal 5 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: The Power of Aggression
cards.text:
Max 2 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Aggression (red) card.

cards.name: The Power of Leadership
cards.text:
Max 2 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.

cards.name: Triage
cards.text: Response: After Triage enters play, heal 2 damage from an [[X-Men]] character.
cards.flavor: "Let me have a look at that."

cards.name: X-23
cards.text: Response: After X-23 attacks and defeats an enemy, ready her.
cards.flavor: "Call me 'Lady-Wolverine' one more time - I dare you!"

cards.name: X-Man
cards.text: Response: After X-Man enters your hand, give your identity a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "The innocent are safe so long as I have anything to say!"

cards.name: Agent Coulson
cards.text: Response: After Agent Coulson enters play, search your deck and discard pile for a [[Preparation]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "I'm a guy with a plan."

cards.name: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 [[Team]] card per player.
If each of your characters has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait, this card gains: "Interrupt: When you reveal an encounter card, exhaust this card → cancel the effects of that card and discard it. Then, reveal another card from the encounter deck."

cards.name: All-Points Bulletin
cards.text:
Hero Action: For each [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support you control, choose:
• Remove 1 threat from a scheme.
• Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Assault
cards.text:
Suit form. Permanent.
Interrupt: When you attack, remove up to 3 threat from here → this attack deals 1 additional damage for each threat removed this way.

cards.name: Command Team
cards.text:
Uses (3 command counters).
Action: Exhaust Command Team and remove 1 command counter from it → ready an ally.

cards.name: Concentrated Fire
cards.text:
Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. This attack gains ranged. If this attack defeats an enemy, choose:
• Place threat on your suit form upgrade equal to that enemy's printed SCH.
• Change to Stealth suit form.

cards.name: Covert Surveillance
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. If you are in Stealth suit form, you may place that threat on your suit form upgrade. Otherwise, you may change to Stealth suit form.

cards.name: Dum Dum Dugan
cards.text: Interrupt: When you use one of Dum Dum Dugan's basic powers, exhaust up to 3 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] cards you control. For each card exhausted this way, Dum Dum Dugan gets +1 to that power for this use.

cards.name: EM Shield
cards.text: Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from an attack, discard EM Shield → prevent all of that damage.

cards.name: Eyepatch Camera
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on the main scheme, discard Eyepatch Camera → place up to 3 of that threat on your suit form upgrade instead.

cards.name: Front Organization
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Interrupt: When an encounter card effect would discard a card you control, discard Front Organization instead of discarding that card.

cards.name: Fury's Flying Car
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Fury's Flying Car and remove 1 threat from your suit form upgrade → ready Nick Fury. He gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "This job has its perks." —Nick Fury

cards.name: Fury's Watch
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust Fury's Watch and remove up to 2 threat from your suit form upgrade → generate a MENTAL resource for each threat you removed this way.

cards.name: Global Logistics
cards.text: Action: Exhaust 1 [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] card you control → look at the top 4 cards of a player deck or the encounter deck. Discard any number of those, and put the others on the top and/or bottom of that deck in any order.

cards.name: Grant Ward
cards.text:
Grant Ward cannot defend.
Forced Response: After you reveal a treachery, you may spend a MENTAL resource. If you do not, take damage equal to Grant Ward's ATK and remove Grant Ward from the game.

cards.name: Informant
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Interrupt: When a minion schemes, discard Informant → this activation removes threat instead of placing it.
cards.flavor: "What's that information worth to you, Coulson?" —Taskmaster

cards.name: Intelligence
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Response: After a player is dealt an encounter card, discard Intelligence → look at each encounter card dealt to each player and the top card of the encounter deck. You may swap any number of those cards.

cards.name: Intelligence Analysis
cards.text: Interrupt: When you reveal a treachery, discard Intelligence Analysis and remove 1 threat from your suit form upgrade → cancel the effects of that treachery and discard it.

cards.name: Jemma Simmons
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to play Jemma Simmons by 2 if your identity has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait.
Resource: Exhaust Jemma Simmons → generate a MENTAL resource for a [[Tech]] card.

cards.name: Leo Fitz
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to play Leo Fitz by 2 if your identity has the [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] trait.
Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Leo Fitz → search you deck for a [[Tech]] card and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Life Model Decoy

Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Stun or confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "I know which nerve clusters can make someone talk, and which can render them silent." —Elektra

cards.name: Ninja Stars
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

STAR Boost: If Elektra is using a basic power, draw 2 cards and shuffle this card into the [[Ninja]] deck. Otherwise, give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

cards.name: Ninja Strike
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

STAR Boost: If Elektra is using a basic power, she gets +3 to that power for this use and you shuffle this card into the [[Ninja]] deck. Otherwise, give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

cards.name: Ninja Vanish
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

STAR Boost: If Elektra is using a basic power, give her a tough status card and shuffle this card into the [[Ninja]] deck. Otherwise, give this card to Elektra as a facedown boost card.

cards.name: Resurrection Altar
cards.text: Interrupt: When you would be defeated, remove this card from the game → set your hit point dial to 9 instead. Find your obligation and reveal it.
cards.flavor: "Arise once again as a mighty servant of the Hand!" —Hand Sorcerer

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.text:
Linked (Double-Cross).
When Revealed: Remove 3 threat from the main scheme. This card gains surge.

STAR Boost: Confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Destroying the control panel now." —Sharon Carter

cards.name: Sai Strike
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. For each Elektra's Sai you control, shuffle the top card of the [[Ninja]] deck into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: "To look upon me is to see the end of life." —Elektra

cards.name: Shang-Chi
cards.text:
Shang-Chi enters play with 10 ring counters on him.
Action: Remove 1 ring counter from here → deal 1 damage to an enemy. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Shuriken
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]]).
Uses (3 shuriken counters).
Hero Action: Remove 1 shuriken counter from here → deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "A true ninja is never without a weapon." —Elektra

cards.name: Stealth Mastery
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When you attack or are attacked, choose to either increase or reduce the damage that attack deals by 3. Put Stealth Mastery on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "I'll teach them to fear every shadow." —Elektra

cards.name: Stone
cards.text: Response: After Stone exactly defeats an enemy or side scheme, heal 2 damage from Stone.
cards.flavor: "Connection, mind, body."

cards.name: White Tiger
cards.text: Response: After you change to hero form, shuffle the top card of the [[Ninja]] deck into the encounter deck. Otherwise, give Elektra 1 facedown boost card.

cards.name: Adam Warlock
cards.text:
Response: After Adam Warlock attacks or thwarts, discard 1 card at random from your hand. If that card's printed resource has:
PHYSICAL – Remove 3 threat from a scheme.
ENERGY – Heal 3 damage from an identity.
MENTAL – Deal 3 damage to an enemy.
WILD – Choose one of the above.

cards.name: Aerial Evacuation
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When another friendly character would be dealt any amount of damage, discard Aerial Evacuation → prevent all of that damage and change to alter-ego form. If that character is a hero, they also change to alter-ego form.

cards.name: Aerial Recon
cards.text:
Hero Action: Exhaust Aerial Recon and deal a player 1 facedown encounter card → place 1 recon counter here.
Interrupt: When a player would be dealt an encounter card, remove 1 recon counter from here instead.

cards.name: Aero
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Aero → choose a player. Until the end of the phase, each [[Aerial]] character that player controls gets +1 ATK.
cards.flavor: "I sense trouble on the wind."

cards.name: Battlefield Awareness
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When Falcon uses a basic power, exhaust Battlefield Awareness and discard the top card of the encounter deck → Falcon gets +1 to that power for this use for each icon (STAR and BOOST) in the discarded card's boost area.

cards.name: Bird of Prey
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. You may discard the top card of the encounter deck to deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each icon (STAR and BOOST) in the discarded card's boost area.

cards.name: Bird's-Eye View
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. You may discard the top card of the encounter deck to remove 1 additional threat from that scheme for each icon (STAR and BOOST) in the discarded card's boost area.

cards.name: Captain America
cards.text:
Play only if you are the Bucky Barnes or Sam Wilson player.
Hero Action: Exhaust Captain America and spend a PHYSICAL resource → find Captain America's Shield and add it to your hand. If it leaves play this way, deal 4 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Captain America's Shield
cards.text:
Linked (Captain America upgrade). Restricted.
Your hero gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "This shield is a symbol of freedom." —Captain America

cards.name: Cloud 9
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Cloud 9 → choose a player. Until the end of the phase, each [[Aerial]] character that player controls gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: "I'm only here 'cause I wanna fly!"

cards.name: Draw Their Fire
cards.text: Hero Response: After the villain phase begins, discard Draw Their Fire → Falcon does not exhaust to defend until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "Now, I can do this all day!" —Falcon

cards.name: Falcon
cards.text:
During the player phase, play with the top card of the encounter deck faceup.
Eagle-Eyed — Response: After you play an [[Aerial]] card, discard the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Falcon's Flock
cards.text:
Uses (5 bird counters).
Resource: Remove 1 bird counter from here → generate a ENERGY resource for an [[Aerial]] card. (Limit once per card.)
cards.flavor: "Have you heard the word?" —Falcon

cards.name: Flight Squadron
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Max 1 [[TEAM]] card per player.
If each of your allies has the [[Aerial]] trait, increase your ally limit by 1 and this card gains: "Response: After you play an [[Aerial]] card, exhaust this card → ready an ally you control."

cards.name: Hugin & Munin
cards.text: Response: After Hugin & Munin enter play, search the top 10 cards of the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with you → ready 1 character you control for each icon (STAR and BOOST) in that minion's boost area.

cards.name: Misty Knight
cards.text: STAR Interrupt: When Misty Knight thwarts, look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and discard 1 of those cards. Misty Knight gets +1 THW for this thwart for each icon (STAR and BOOST) in the discarded card's boost area.

cards.name: Ops Room
cards.text:
Uses (3 alert counters).
Interrupt: When a friendly character would take any amount of damage while defending, remove 1 alert counter from here → prevent 1 of that damage and remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Redwing
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust Redwing, return him to your hand, and discard the top card of the encounter deck → choose to either deal X damage to an enemy or remove X threat from a scheme. X is the number of icons (STAR and BOOST) in the discarded card's boost area.

cards.name: Resource Reserve
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Any player may spend the resource card tucked here as if it were in their hand.
Action: Exhaust Resource Reserve → tuck 1 resource card from your hand under here (to a maximum of 1).

cards.name: Sam Wilson
cards.text: Birds of a Feather — Action: Discard 1 card from your hand → search your deck and discard pile for a [[Bird]] card and add it to your hand. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Soup Kitchen
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Sam Wilson and Soup Kitchen → heal damage from Sam Wilson equal to his REC and reduce the cost of the next ally or support played this phase by 2.
cards.flavor: In following his parents' examples of service, Sam sets an example for others.

cards.name: Spectrum
cards.text:
Response: After you play Spectrum, tuck 1 card used to pay for her under her. If that card's printed resource has:
MENTAL – Spectrum gets +2 THW.
PHYSICAL – Spectrum gets +2 ATK.
ENERGY – Spectrum gets +2 hit points.
WILD – All of the above.

cards.name: Strength in Diversity
cards.text:
Alliance.
Hero Action: For each different [[Trait]] on friendly characters in play, choose:
• Remove 1 threat from a scheme.
• Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Talon Line
cards.text:
Hero Response: After you resolve Falcon's "Eagle-Eyed" ability, discard Talon Line → for each icon in the discarded card's boost area, choose 1:
• Ready a character you control.
• Stun an enemy.

cards.name: Up, Up, and Away
cards.text: Hero Response (defense): After an attacking enemy is given a facedown boost card, look at that card and the top card of the encounter deck. You may swap those cards. Draw 1 card for each printed icon (STAR and BOOST) in the (current) boost card's boost area.

cards.name: Vibranium Microweave
cards.text:
Falcon gets +1 DEF.
Hero Interrupt: When Falcon would take any amount of damage, exhaust Vibranium Microweave → prevent 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Wingman
cards.text:
Attach to an [[Aerial]] ally. Max 1 per ally.
Interrupt: When another [[Aerial]] ally would take any amount of consequential damage, exhaust attached ally → prevent 1 of that damage.

cards.name: Winter Soldier
cards.text: Response: After Winter Soldier attacks and defeats an enemy, remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "As long as I'm alive, you'll never fight alone."

cards.name: Acute Tactility
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy or scheme.
Interrupt: When you defeat attached enemy or remove the last threat from attached scheme, discard this card → ready your identity.

cards.name: American Sign Language
cards.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust this card → generate a WILD resource for an event being played by any player.
cards.flavor:
* —Echo
*Translated from ASL.

cards.name: Army of One
cards.text:
STAR Increase the cost to play this card by 1 for each ally you control.
Hero Action: Ready your hero.
cards.flavor: "Two versus one is not a fair fight...for you." —Daredevil

cards.name: Art Museum Heist
cards.text: Setup: Give each identity a tough status card.
cards.flavor: You draw inspiration from the works of art you secured against theft.

cards.name: Art Museum Heist
cards.text: Setup: Each player chooses to stun or confuse their identity (in expert mode, do both instead).
cards.flavor: You are demoralized by your failure to prevent the museum art theft.

cards.name: Blindspot
cards.text: STAR Response: After Blindspot thwarts, confuse an enemy with an upgrade attached.
cards.flavor: "I'm invisible, but I'm still here. Chinatown is where I live and I'm going to protect it."

cards.name: Bloody Mary
cards.text:
Victory -1.
STAR Forced Response: After you reveal a side scheme, remove all damage from here and flip this card.

cards.name: Chance Encounter
cards.text:
Attach to a side scheme. Max 1 per scheme.
Interrupt: When attached side scheme is defeated, search your deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Choreography
cards.text: Action: Exhaust this card → shuffle 1 aspect or basic event from your discard pile into your deck. If you are in alter-ego form, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: Maya uses her physical gifts to express herself in dance.

cards.name: Cloak
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Cloak and spend ENERGY ENERGY resources → find Dagger and put her into play.

cards.name: Contingency Planning
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
You may play the upgrade tucked here as if it were in your hand.
Action: Choose 1 upgrade in your hand that can attach to a minion or side scheme. Tuck that upgrade under here (to a maximum of 1).

cards.name: Cross-Examination
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. For each upgrade attached to that enemy, you may deal 1 additional damage to it.
cards.flavor: "No further questions, punk." —Daredevil

cards.name: Dagger
cards.text:
Cloak loses each ACCELERATION icon.
STAR If Cloak is in play, Dagger takes -1 consequential damage after she uses a basic power.
cards.flavor: "I'll be the light in your dark, Ty."

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: Superhuman Senses — Action: Play the top card of the [[Sense]] deck as if it were in your hand (paying its cost).

cards.name: Daredevil
cards.text: STAR Response: After Daredevil uses a basic power, reduce the cost of the next event you play this round by 1.
cards.flavor: "Follow my lead."

cards.name: Daredevil's Billy Club
cards.text:
Restricted. Daredevil gets +1 ATK.
Hero Action: Return this card to your hand (from play) → choose:
• Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
• Daredevil gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the round.

cards.name: De-escalation
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Remove an acceleration token from play.
cards.flavor: "I can see my house from here!" —Civilian

cards.name: Deposition
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): You may choose any upgrade from the [[Sense]] deck and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Do not shuffle.) Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Tell us everything." —Matt Murdock

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Watch and Learn — Response: After a player plays an aspect or basic event, tuck that event under here from that player's discard pile. Then, if there are more than 3 tucked cards here, discard all but 3 of those cards.

cards.name: Echo's Katana
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Response (attack): After you play an event, exhaust Echo's Katana → deal damage to an enemy equal to that event's printed cost. This attack gains piercing.

cards.name: Elektra
cards.text: STAR Forced Interrupt (Hero): When Elektra would take consequential damage, Daredevil takes that damage instead.
cards.flavor: "I don't need your protection, Matt."

cards.name: Enhanced Olfaction
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy or scheme.
Interrupt: When you defeat attached enemy or remove the last threat from attached scheme, discard this card → reduce the cost of the next card you play this phase by 2.

cards.name: Focus the Senses
cards.text:
Threat cannot be removed from this scheme except by Daredevil or Matt Murdock.
When Defeated: You may move any number of [[Sense]] upgrades in play to other cards they can attach to. Choose any number of upgrades from the [[Sense]] deck and put them into play. (Do not shuffle.)

cards.name: Foggy Nelson
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Foggy Nelson → remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "Everything's okay now, Matt! Ol' Fog is on it!"

cards.name: Get Their Attention
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense/thwart): When an enemy initiates an attack, remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor:
"I think we made 'em mad."
"What do you mean 'we'?"
—Rocket Raccoon and Gamora

cards.name: Ghost Rider
cards.text: STAR Interrupt: When Ghost Rider attacks an enemy, spend a ENERGY resource (ENERGY ENERGY resources instead if that enemy is the villain) → confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "My penance stare reveals all of your past sins!"

cards.name: Heightened Hearing
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy.
Hero Interrupt (defense): When attached enemy attacks, discard this card → that enemy gets -3 ATK for that attack. (You become the target of that attack.)

cards.name: Improvisation
cards.text:
Hero Response: After you play an event, if it has the following traits:
• [[Attack]] — heal 1 damage from Echo.
• [[Defense]] — remove 1 threat from a scheme.
• [[Thwart]] — deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: In Harm's Way
cards.text:
STAR Increase the cost to play this card by 1 for each ally you control.
Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal X damage to an enemy and remove X threat from a scheme, where X is your DEF.

cards.name: Innate Reflexes
cards.text:
Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.)
Your hero gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: KTINK!

cards.name: Karen Page
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Karen Page → shuffle 1 Daredevil card from your discard pile into your deck. If you are in alter-ego form, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "What would you boys do without me?"

cards.name: Know Your Enemy
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]]).
Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 threat from a scheme. Remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "I don't need to see you to know your next move." —Iron Fist

cards.name: Legal Trouble
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Attorney]] or [[Police]]).
Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attached minion gets -2 SCH.
cards.flavor: "You got a permit for that?" —Police officer

cards.name: Living Lie Detector
cards.text: Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. For each upgrade attached to that scheme, you may remove 1 additional threat from it.
cards.flavor: Thump-Thump     Thump-Thump    Thump-Thump   Thump-Thump  Thump-Thump Thump-Thump

cards.name: Matt Murdock
cards.text:
Matt Murdock begins the game with a [[Sense]] deck. (See rulebook p. 26.)
Forced Interrupt: When a [[Sense]] upgrade would leave play, place it on the bottom of the [[Sense]] deck instead.

cards.name: Maya Lopez
cards.text: Practice Makes Perfect — Interrupt: When you change to hero form, search your deck for an aspect or basic event and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: Maya can recreate any physical movement she sees.

cards.name: Move in Shadow
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Spy]]).
Temporary. Max 1 per player.
Response (thwart): After you play a card (including this one), remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Muscle Memory
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card → add an event tucked under Echo to your hand.
cards.flavor: "I absorb an arsenal of actions, so when I need to, I can perform them with the same precision." —Echo

cards.name: Nelson and Murdock
cards.text: Response: After an [[Attorney]] character or support defeats a side scheme, confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Let's see them pull off their heist with their vehicle impounded." —Matt Murdock

cards.name: Photographic Reflexes
cards.text: STAR If you are in hero form, you can discard Photographic Reflexes from your hand to play an event tucked under Echo as if it were in your hand. Reduce the cost to play that event by 2. You cannot trigger Echo's "Watch and Learn" ability for that event.

cards.name: Powerful Punch
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, deal 4 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "That was my favorite shirt!" —Luke Cage

cards.name: Protection Racket
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for a support and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.
cards.flavor: You stood up for the neighborhood businesses, giving the community the courage to rally around you.

cards.name: Protection Racket
cards.text: Setup: Each player chooses and discards 1 card from their hand (in expert mode, 2 cards instead).
cards.flavor: Threats against the neighborhood businesses have left the community too frightened to help you.

cards.name: Radar Sense
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy.
Response (attack): After you attack attached enemy, discard this card → deal 3 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: The accident that cost Matt his eyesight gave him a new, radar-like sense.

cards.name: Raising Hell
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to each enemy for each upgrade attached to that enemy (3 damage instead if Daredevil has the [[Aerial]] trait).
cards.flavor: "I cannot see the light. So I will be the light. I am Daredevil, and I am not afraid." —Daredevil

cards.name: Ronin
cards.text: While you do not control any allies, your hero gets +1 DEF and gains retaliate 1.
cards.flavor: "I am Ronin, the samurai with no master." —Ronin

cards.name: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
cards.text:
Team-Up (Daredevil and Echo). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action (attack/thwart): Choose 2 of the following (you may choose the same option twice):
• Deal 3 damage to an enemy.
• Remove 3 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Sister Maggie
cards.text:
Matt Murdock gets +3 REC.
Response: After you recover, discard a status card from your identity.
cards.flavor: As both a Catholic nun and Matt's mother, Sister Maggie often nurses her son back to health.

cards.name: Stand Alone
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Hero Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you (before any defender is declared), if you do not control any allies, exhaust Stand Alone → ready your hero.

cards.name: Stealth Training
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Response: After you thwart and exactly defeat a side scheme, exhaust Stealth Training → stun an enemy.

cards.name: Stick
cards.text:
Interrupt: When a friendly [[Martial Artist]] character uses a basic power, choose:
• Exhaust Stick → that character gets +1 to that basic power for this use.
• That character gets -1 to that basic power for this use. Ready Stick.

cards.name: Stop the Presses!
cards.text: Setup: Each player puts 1 [[Daily Bugle]] support (that has not been removed from the campaign) into play from the Stop the Presses! encounter set.
cards.flavor: J. Jonah Jameson has promised the help of his Daily Bugle staff in gratitude for protecting his newspaper. You don't expect it to last.

cards.name: Stop the Presses!
cards.text: Setup: Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (in expert mode, 2 encounter cards instead).
cards.flavor: Following the ransacking of the Daily Bugle offices, every media outlet in the city is too scared to help in your efforts to stop the crime wave, and you suspect some are even working with the criminals.

cards.name: Study the Tape
cards.text: Action: Search any player's discard pile for 1 aspect event, 1 basic event, or 1 copy of Photographic Reflexes and add that card to your hand.
cards.flavor: "I watch tape after tape to train for a fight." —Echo

cards.name: Superior Taste
cards.text:
Attach to a scheme.
Response (thwart): After you thwart attached scheme, discard this card → remove 2 threat from that scheme.

cards.name: Superpower Training
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an identity-specific upgrade and put it into play. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Eat light daggers, you purple punk!" —Dagger

cards.name: The Best Offense...
cards.text:
Temporary.
Your hero gets +1 DEF.
Use your DEF in place of your THW and ATK. (Ignore any modifiers to your THW and ATK.)

cards.name: The Getaway
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.
cards.flavor: The bank provides you a generous reward as thanks for returning the stolen money.

cards.name: The Getaway
cards.text:
In expert mode, attachments cannot be discarded from play during the first round.
Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for an attachment and reveals it. Deal a facedown encounter card to each player who could not.
cards.flavor: Your enemies have put their ill-gotten gains towards improving their armaments.

cards.name: The Man Without Fear
cards.text:
Hero Action: Exhaust this card and deal 1 damage to Daredevil → choose:
• Choose any upgrade from the [[Sense]] deck and play it, ignoring its resource cost. (Do not shuffle.)
• Ready Daredevil.

cards.name: The Raft Breakout
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.
cards.flavor: Your work in securing the Raft has freed up other heroes to help you take down the next villain.

cards.name: The Raft Breakout
cards.text: Setup: Shuffle each minion in The Raft Breakout encounter set into the encounter deck (in expert mode, deal 1 of those minions at random to each player as a facedown encounter card before shuffling in the rest).
cards.flavor: Many dangerous fugitives are on the loose thanks to your failure at the Raft.

cards.name: The Rez
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Rez → heal X damage from Maya Lopez, where X is the highest cost among cards tucked under her.
cards.flavor: The Rez is not a real reservation or Native nation, but a place for all tribes.

cards.name: Typhoid Mary
cards.text:
Setup. Victory -1.
STAR Forced Response: After you reveal a minion, remove all damage from here and flip this card.

cards.name: Acrobatic Move
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "If you really knew me as well as you thought you did, you would not have attacked me." —Gamora

cards.name: Angela
cards.text: Forced Response: After Angela enters play under your control, search the top 10 cards of the encounter deck for a minion and put it into play engaged with you. Shuffle the encounter deck. If a minion was not put into play this way, discard Angela.

cards.name: Comms Implant
cards.text:
Attach to a [GUARDIAN] ally. Max 1 per ally.
Attached ally gets +1 THW and +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: "So... you come here often?" —Peter Quill

cards.name: Conditioning Room
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Conditioning Room → return the bottommost [ATTACK] or [THWART] event from your discard pile to your hand. Heal 1 damage from Gamora.
cards.flavor: "I'm always prepared." —Gamora

cards.name: Crosscounter
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (attack/defense/thwart): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 3 of that damage. Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "That decision will be your last!" —Gamora

cards.name: Decisive Blow
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy (7 damage instead if you have played a [THWART] event this turn).
cards.flavor: "Thanos built me for one purpose: to kill. He'll soon realize that was a poor decision." —Gamora

cards.name: Drax
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [GUARDIAN] trait.
Drax cannot attack minions.
cards.flavor: "Behold, this battle has raised my spirits greatly!"

cards.name: Enhanced Reflexes
cards.text: Uses (3 energy counters). Hero Resource: Exhaust Enhanced Reflexes and remove 1 energy counter from it → generate a ENERGY resource.

cards.name: First Hit
cards.text:
Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to the villain.
Hero Interrupt (attack): When a minion initiates an attack, deal 2 damage to that minion.

cards.name: Forward Momentum
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme (5 threat instead if you have played an [ATTACK] event this turn).
cards.flavor: "This isn't going to go well for you." —Gamora

cards.name: Gamora
cards.text:
Finesse — Response: After you play an [ATTACK] event, remove 1 threat from a scheme. (Limit once per phase.)
Precision — Response: After you play a [THWART] event, deal 1 damage to an enemy. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Gamora
cards.text:
Skilled Tactician — You may include up to 6 [ATTACK] and/or [THWART] events in your deck from aspects other than your chosen aspect.
Action: Look at the top card of your deck. If that card is an [ATTACK] or [THWART] event, draw it. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Gamora's Sword
cards.text:
Restricted. (Max 2 restricted cards per player).
Response: After you play an [ATTACK] event, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Godslayer
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Interrupt: When your hero makes a basic attack against a unique enemy (UNIQUE), exhaust Godslayer → your hero gets +2 ATK for that attack.

cards.name: Hit and Run
cards.text: Hero Action (attack/thwart): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "You know, Lady Gamora, even when we first met—while I was beating you to death—I thought to myself, 'I bet she and I could be friends.'" —Angela

cards.name: Impede
