cards.flavor: "Smashing is what Hulk does best!" —Hulk

cards.name: Electrostatic Armor
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Response: After you defend against an attack, deal 1 damage to the attacking character.

cards.name: Hulk
cards.text: "Enraged" — Forced Interrupt: When your turn ends, discard your hand.
cards.flavor: "Hulk is not sorry. Hulk is Hulk."

cards.name: Hulk Smash
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack, you get +10 ATK for that attack. If you paid for this card using only PHYSICAL resources, that attack gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "When Hulk smash something, it stay smashed!" —Hulk

cards.name: Immovable Object
cards.text:
You get +4 hit points.
Hulk gains retaliate 1.

cards.name: Inspiring Presence
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait.
Hero Action: Heal 1 damage from an ally and ready it.

cards.name: Limitless Strength
cards.text: Spend this card only in hero form.

cards.name: Martial Prowess
cards.text:
Play under any player's control.
Max 1 per player.
Resource: Exhaust Martial Prowess → generate a PHYSICAL resource for an [[Attack]] event.

cards.name: Resourceful
cards.text: Resource: Discard Resourceful → generate a WILD resource.
cards.flavor: "Innovation is the ultimate weapon." —Vision

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: Forced Response: After Sentry enters play under your control, deal yourself 1 encounter card.
cards.flavor: "When I use my powers of a million exploding suns, I unleash the Void. He attacks the world every time I try to save it."

cards.name: She-Hulk
cards.text: STAR She-Hulk gets +1 ATK for each damage token here.
cards.flavor: "I'd ask your to surrender... but I'm really hoping you'll put up a fight."

cards.name: Sub-Orbital Leap
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme (5 threat instead if you paid for this card using only PHYSICAL resources).
cards.flavor: "Leave Hulk alone!" —Hulk

cards.name: Thunderclap
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose up to 3 different enemies. Deal 3 damage to each of them.
cards.flavor: "Are you afraid of Hulk's little wind?" —Hulk

cards.name: To the Rescue!
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Toe to Toe
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Choose an enemy. That enemy attacks you. Deal 5 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "How about a taste of your own medicine?" —Captain Marvel

cards.name: Unstoppable Force
cards.text: Hero Action: Ready Hulk. If you paid for this card using only PHYSICAL resources, draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Nobody stop Hulk!" —Hulk

cards.name: Arctic Attack
cards.text:
Hero Action (attack): Choose:
• Deal 4 damage to an enemy and attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to it.
• Deal 6 damage to an enemy with Frostbite attached.

cards.name: Beak
cards.text: Response: After you play Beak from your hand, remove 1 threat from a scheme for each [[X-Men]] ally you control.
cards.flavor: "I'm not really strong and I don't shoot death-rays, but I am good at making friends."

cards.name: Bobby Drake
cards.text:
Bobby Drake begins the game with 6 Frostbite upgrades set aside.
Cool Off — Response: After you change to this form, shuffle 1 [[Ice]] card from your discard pile into your deck for each copy of Frostbite in play.

cards.name: Chill Out!
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Seriously, dude. I'm all out of ice puns." —Iceman

cards.name: Cryokinetic Perception
cards.text: Hero Response: After you resolve your "Freeze!" ability, exhaust this card → draw 1 card. If that card has an [[Ice]] trait, ready Iceman.
cards.flavor: "Anyone remember when I used to throw snowballs at Magneto?" —Iceman

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.text:
Permanent.
Attached enemy gets -1 SCH and -1 ATK.
Forced Response: After attached enemy activates or leaves play, set this card aside.

cards.name: Frozen Solid
cards.text:
Hero form only. Attach to an enemy. Max 1 per enemy.
Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would activate, discard Frozen Solid instead. Then, attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to that enemy.

cards.name: Glob
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait.
Response: After Glob enters play, deal 2 damage to an enemy with an upgrade attached.

cards.name: Ice Blast
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose a player. Attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Deal 3 damage to each enemy with a copy of Frostbite attached.
cards.flavor: "Time to put these guys on ice." —Iceman

cards.name: Ice Slide
cards.text:
Iceman gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF, and gains the [[Aerial]] trait.
Forced Response: After you change to alter-ego form, shuffle this card into your deck.

cards.name: Ice Wall
cards.text: Forced Interrupt: When an identity would take any amount of damage from an enemy attack, place that damage here instead. Then, if there is at least 8 damage here, discard this card and attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to the enemy that just attacked.

cards.name: Iceman
cards.text: "Freeze!" — Interrupt: When Iceman makes a basic attack or defense against an enemy, attach a set-aside copy of Frostbite to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Here comes the coolest hero on the team!"

cards.name: Keep Up the Pressure
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an [[Attack]] event and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.) Until the end of the phase, each [[Attack]] event deals 1 additional damage.

cards.name: Power Belt
cards.text:
You get +3 hit points.
Hero Resource: Exhaust Power Belt → generate a WILD resource for an [[Ice]] card.
cards.flavor: Beast made this high-tech belt to help Iceman better control his powers.

cards.name: Recuperation
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Heal damage from your alter-ego equal to your REC.
cards.flavor: "You'll be fine." —Dr. Rao

cards.name: Shadowcat
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait.
Response: After you play Shadowcat from your hand, choose a side scheme in play → that scheme loses each ACCELERATION, AMPLIFY, CRISIS, and HAZARD icon until the end of the round.

cards.name: Shark-Girl
cards.text: STAR While Shark-Girl is attacking an enemy, she gets +1 ATK for each upgrade attached to that enemy.
cards.flavor: The only thing scarier than a ravenous teenager is one who can turn into a shark.

cards.name: Snow Clone
cards.text:
Cannot have upgrades attached.
STAR Snow Clone takes -1 consequential damage (COST) after it attacks an enemy with Frostbite attached.
cards.flavor: "You could say he's got an icy demeanor." —Iceman

cards.name: Surprise Move
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you make a basic attack against an enemy with an upgrade attached, you get +2 ATK for this attack. If this attack defeats that enemy, ready your hero.

cards.name: Take That!
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy with an upgrade attached.
cards.flavor: "And don't come back!" —Magik

cards.name: The Power in All of Us
cards.text:
Max 2 per deck.
Double the number of resources this card generates when paying for a Basic (gray) card.

cards.name: Book of the Iron Fist
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust this card → if the top card of your discard pile is a [[Technique]], put it into play.
cards.flavor: This tome recounts the lives of all Immortal Weapons who've earned the title of Iron Fist.

cards.name: Channel the Iron Fist
cards.text:
Temporary.
Hero Interrupt: When you attack, remove 1 chi counter from Iron Fist → increase the amount of damage that attack deals by 1 (by 2 instead if it is a basic attack).

cards.name: Colleen Wing
cards.text: STAR Colleen Wing takes -1 consequential damage after she attacks an enemy who has been attacked by another [[Martial Artist]] character this phase.
cards.flavor: "Even I'd admit, she is probably the best samurai sword fighter outside of Japan." —Razor Fist

cards.name: Danny Rand
cards.text:
Your [[Technique]] cards lose temporary.
Meditation — Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a [[Technique]] card. Put that card into play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "My name is Daniel Rand. I am the Iron Fist and I know kung fu."

cards.name: Death by a Thousand Cuts
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Soldier]]).
Temporary. Max 1 per player.
Response (attack): After you play a card (including this one), deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Deep Breathing
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard an Iron Fist card and add it to your hand.
cards.flavor: "In through the nose, out through the mouth." —Danny Rand

cards.name: Defiance
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a boost card on an enemy attacking you would be turned faceup, discard it instead.
cards.flavor: "No." —Shang-Chi

cards.name: Demoralize
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose an enemy. It attacks you. Confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "That axe is not all I'm gonna break." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Dragon Punch
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. You may remove up to 5 chi counters from your identity to deal 2 additional damage for each chi counter removed this way. If you removed at least 3 counters, also stun that enemy.

cards.name: Embody the Dragon
cards.text:
Temporary.
Iron Fist gains retaliate X, where X is equal to the number of chi counters on this card.
Hero Action: Move 1 chi counter from Iron Fist to this card.

cards.name: Feel the Flow
cards.text:
Temporary.
Hero Action (thwart): Remove 1 chi counter from Iron Fist → remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "My mind is empty. I am formless and shapeless. I am as water." —Iron Fist

cards.name: Fists of Fury
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Kiai, kiai...wah CHA!" —Iron Fist

cards.name: Helpful Bystander
cards.text:
Vulnerable. Max 1 per deck.
Your hero gets +1 hand size.
Forced Interrupt: When an enemy attacks you, it attacks Helpful Bystander instead. This attack gains overkill.

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.text:
Martial Arts Master — Response: After you play a card, place 1 chi counter here.
Forced Response: After the player phase ends, remove all but 4 chi counters from here and heal 1 damage for each chi counter removed this way.

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.text: STAR Response: After Iron Fist (this ally) attacks an enemy who has been attacked by a hero this phase, stun that enemy. If Iron Fist defeated that enemy, he takes -2 consequential damage from this attack.

cards.name: Keep 'Em Coming
cards.text:
Temporary.
Hero Action: Remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist → ready him.
cards.flavor: "I'm not trying to get out of this fight. I'm just giving you a chance to flee." —Iron Fist

cards.name: Lei Kung
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Lei Kung and remove 1 chi counter from your identity → draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "I don't know how he earned the moniker 'the Thunderer' and I've been afraid to ask." —Danny Rand

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text:
Toughness.
If your hero shares a [[Trait]] with Luke Cage, your hero gets +1 DEF.
cards.flavor: "They don't call ol' Luke Cage 'Power Man' for nothin'!"

cards.name: No Time to Bleed
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]] or [[Soldier]]).
Temporary. Max 1 per player.
Response: After you play a card (including this one), heal 1 damage from your identity.

cards.name: Power Man and Iron Fist
cards.text:
Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.

cards.name: Punch, Reverse Punch
cards.text:
STAR Discount 1 ([[Martial Artist]]).
Hero Action (attack): Deal 1 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "It never hurts to practice even the basic forms." —Shang-Chi

cards.name: Redirect Chi
cards.text:
Temporary.
Hero Resource: Remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist → generate WILDWILD resources.
cards.flavor: "Let it flow." —Lei Kung

cards.name: Redirection Mastery
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Hero Response: After you exactly defend an attack, deal damage to the attacker equal to your DEF for that attack.

cards.name: Sensei
cards.text:
STAR Discount 2 ([[Martial Artist]]).
Max 1 per player.
Each [[Martial Artist]] ally you control takes -2 consequential damage after they exactly defeat an enemy or side scheme.

cards.name: The Defenders
cards.text: This card generates a PHYSICAL resource for each [[Defender]] character you control (to a maximum of 4) and can be spent for another player whose identity has the [[Defender]] trait.

cards.name: The Way of Things
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. You may remove 2 chi counters from Iron Fist to remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "When there is no desire, all things are at peace." —Lao Tzu

cards.name: Thunder Dojo
cards.text:
Prerequisite ([[Defender]] or [[Martial Artist]]).
Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card → shuffle up to 2 [[Attack]] events from your discard pile into your deck. Any player may trigger this ability.
cards.flavor: "I love giving back to the community." —Danny Rand

cards.name: Tonfa
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Interrupt: When calculating damage during an attack against you, exhaust this card → give your hero either +1 DEF or retaliate 1 for this attack.

cards.name: Zen-Like Calm
cards.text: Action: Heal 1 damage from a [[Martial Artist]] character. Then, if that character has no sustained damage, heal 1 damage from another character.
cards.flavor: "Matt, adjust your posture. Let your body relax. Bring your attention to your breath." —Iron Fist

cards.name: "Go for Champions!"
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
Hero Action: Remove "Go for Champions!" from the game → Each [CHAMPION] character in play cannot take damage until the end of the round.

cards.name: Agent 13
cards.text: STAR Response: After Agent 13 attacks or thwarts, choose a [[S.H.I.E.L.D.]] support → ready that support.
cards.flavor: "I bear the scars of the past all over me. But there's more to me than that. I'm better now. Stronger. Wiser."

cards.name: Bombshell
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
STAR Divide damage from Bombshell's attack among each enemy as evenly as possible.

cards.name: Brawn
cards.text: While Brawn is exhausted, he gains: "Resource: Generate a MENTAL resource. (Limit once per phase.)"
cards.flavor: "No, I'm not Banner. I'm better."

cards.name: Falcon
cards.text: Hero Response: After Falcon attacks or thwarts, spend a ENERGY resource → ready another [CHAMPION] character you control.
cards.flavor: "Hey, uh, it's Joaquín. I'm here to rescue you. And, uh, good thing, right?"

cards.name: Fly Over
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme and place 1 progress counter on Ironheart (2 progress counters instead if this thwart removes the last threat from that scheme).
cards.flavor: VRROOOSSHH!

cards.name: Go All Out
cards.text:
Requirement (ENERGY). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.)
Hero Action (attack): Exhaust your hero → deal damage to an enemy equal to the total of your hero's THW, ATK, and DEF values.

cards.name: Ingenuity
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Genius]] trait. Max 1 per player.
Resource: Exhaust Ingenuity → generate a MENTAL resource.

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Level Up! — Action: Remove 6 progress counters from Ironheart → ready her and swap her with [[Version 2]] Ironheart.
cards.flavor: "Time to try this untested bit of business..."

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Level Up! — Action: Remove 6 progress counters from Ironheart → ready her, give her a tough status card, and swap her with [[Version 3]] Ironheart.
cards.flavor: "It's Ironheart, bro."

cards.name: Ironheart
cards.text: Maximum Efficiency — Hero Action: Remove 1 progress counter from Ironheart → deal 2 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh, you wanna play, villain person? Let's play."

cards.name: Morale Boost
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose a hero. Until the end of the round, that hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF
cards.flavor: "This is a stand I need to take. This time, no compromises." —Sam Wilson

cards.name: New and Improved
cards.text:
Hero Action: Choose X different options, where X is equal to Ironheart's [VERSION] number:
• Search your deck for an Ironheart card and add it to your hand. (Shuffle.)
• Give Ironheart a tough status card.
• Ready Ironheart.

cards.name: Patriot
cards.text: Hero Response: After Patriot enters play, choose a [CHAMPION] character → that character gets +1 to each of its basic powers until the end of the round.
cards.flavor: "I'm surrounded by those who risk their lives for principles most people take for granted."

cards.name: Photon Beam
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy and place 1 progress counter on Ironheart (2 progress counters instead if this attack defeats that enemy).
cards.flavor: FSHHAAMMM!

cards.name: Photon Blasters
cards.text:
You get +2 hit points.
Hero Action: Exhaust Photon Blasters → deal damage to an enemy equal to Ironheart's [[Version]] number.

cards.name: Pinpoint
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
Hero Interrupt: When a player card would be placed into a discard pile from play, exhaust Pinpoint → shuffle that card into its owner's deck instead.

cards.name: Propulsion Jets
cards.text:
You get +2 hit points.
Hero Action: Exhaust Propulsion Jets → remove threat from a scheme equal to Ironheart's [[Version]] number.

cards.name: Push Ahead
cards.text:
Requirement (MENTAL). (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.)
Hero Action (thwart): Exhaust your hero → remove threat from a scheme equal to the total of your hero's THW, ATK, and DEF values.

cards.name: R&D Facility
cards.text:
Requirement (MENTALMENTAL). Uses (3 research counters).
Hero Action: Exhaust R&D Facility and remove 1 research counter from it → choose a friendly character in play. That character gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text:
Begin the game with this card. Set your other identities aside. (See insert.)
Child Prodigy — Action: Spend a MENTAL resource → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text: Child Prodigy — Action: Spend a MENTAL resource or 2 resources of any type → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "Just let me finish this up, then I'll eat and frolic and do whatever."

cards.name: Riri Williams
cards.text: Child Prodigy — Action: Spend 1 resource of any type → place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I can build something lighter, faster, stronger."

cards.name: Ronnie Williams
cards.text:
Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Ronnie Williams → choose:
• Heal 2 damage from Riri Williams.
• Place 1 progress counter on Riri Williams.

cards.name: Sector Scan
cards.text:
Reduce the cost to play Sector Scan by X, where X is equal to Ironheart's [VERSION] number.
Hero Action: Until the end of the round, you may look at the top card of the encounter deck at any time.

cards.name: Snowguard
cards.text:
Response: After Snowguard enters play, place up to 3 shift counters here. While the shift counters here are equal to (X), she gets:
(1) +3 ATK and her attacks gain overkill.
(2) +3 THW and gains the [[Aerial]] trait.
(3) +5 hit points and gains retaliate 1.

cards.name: Stroke of Genius
cards.text: Response: After you spend this card, place 1 progress counter on your identity and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Tony Stark A.I.
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Tony Stark A.I. → look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 to your hand and discard the other.
cards.flavor: "I downloaded my fabulous self into a digital frame in case my body was ever... you know, not working anymore."

cards.name: Vivian
cards.text: Hero Response: After Vivian enters play, choose an attachment, non-[[Elite]] minion, or non-permanent side scheme. Until the end of the round, treat that card's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Champion]] trait.
Wasp ignores the guard keyword, patrol keyword, and crisis icon (CRISIS).
cards.flavor: "Gotta find me first!"

cards.name: "Big Mistake"
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may remove 1 evidence counter from Alias Investigations to deal 2 additional damage and for this attack to gain either overkill or piercing.
cards.flavor: "You messed with the wrong lady." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: "Now I'm Ticked Off!"
cards.text: Forced Response (attack): After the villain activates against a player, if you are in alter-ego form, change to hero form. Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with that player. Discard this card.
cards.flavor: "What did you just say to her?" —Jessica Jones

cards.name: 4K Digital Camcorder
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust this card and choose a non-[[Elite]] minion. Remove X evidence counters from Alias Investigations, where X is equal to 2 less than that minion's remaining hit points → discard that minion.
cards.flavor: "...gotcha." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Alias Investigations
cards.text:
Permanent.
Response: After a side scheme is defeated, exhaust this card → place 2 evidence counters here. Then, you may remove evidence counters from here equal to the villain's remaining hit points to defeat the villain's current stage.

cards.name: Breakthrough
cards.text: Response: After an evidence counter is placed on Alias Investigations, ready your identity. Shuffle this card into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Tell me more." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Calling in Favors
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Remove 2 evidence counters from Alias Investigations and exhaust Calling in Favors → search your deck for an ally and play it as if it were in your hand, reducing its resource cost by 2. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Captain Marvel
cards.text: Response: After Captain Marvel enters play, discard the top 4 cards of your deck. If you discard a printed ENERGY resource, remove 2 threat from a scheme. If you discard more than one printed ENERGY resource, also confuse an enemy.

cards.name: Circumstantial Evidence
cards.text: Response: After an enemy is defeated, exhaust Circumstantial Evidence → place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "Nice find! That'll come in handy." —Daredevil

cards.name: Defend Our City
cards.text:
STAR Hinder 1PER HERO.
Prerequisite ([[Defender]]). Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and add it to their hand. Until the end of the phase, reduce the cost to play each Team-Up card by 1.

cards.name: Determination
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Hero Response: After you spend this card, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.
cards.flavor: The facepaint Echo applies is in remembrance of her late father's last touch.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text:
Max 1 per player.
Alter-Ego Response (attack): After the villain schemes, change to hero form and discard this card → deal damage to the villain equal to the amount of threat placed by that activation.

cards.name: Grapnel Launcher
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Action: Discard this card → make a basic thwart without exhausting (even if you are exhausted). For this thwart, your hero gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword and any crisis icons (CRISIS) in play.

cards.name: Hellcat
cards.text: If your identity has the [[Defender]] trait, this card gains: "Action: Put Hellcat into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, discard her."
cards.flavor: "Hi Fellas! Well, tootles."

cards.name: Innate Aggression
cards.text:
Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.)
Your hero gets +1 ATK.
cards.flavor: SMACK!

cards.name: Innate Inspiration
cards.text:
Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.)
Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.flavor: PA-PA_POW!

cards.name: Innate Perception
cards.text:
Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.)
Your hero gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: WHOOOSH!

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: STAR Gather Evidence — Response: After you use a basic power, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "These things rarely end well."

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text:
Incognito Mode — Action: Change to hero form. You cannot change back to alter-ego form this phase.
Setup: Put the Alias Investigations support into play.

cards.name: Joys of Life
cards.text:
Alliance.
Action: Choose:
• Exhaust a [[Civilian]] alter-ego → ready a hero or ally.
• Exhaust a hero or ally → ready a [[Civilian]] alter-ego.

cards.name: Lay Low
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.
cards.flavor: "I'm sure the nice old Estonian couple that owns this place won't mind if we crash here for a bit." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Lay the Trap
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme deals 5PER HERO damage to the villain.
cards.flavor:
"You go right, I'll go left."
"I always go right."
"Fine, go left."
"I like going right."
—Daredevil and Iron Fist

cards.name: Leather Jacket
cards.text:
Jessica Jones gets +2 DEF.
Response: After you defend, place 1 evidence counter on Alias Investigations.
cards.flavor: "Luke, does she own any jackets that aren't black leather?" —Iron Fist

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text:
Toughness.
Action: Exhaust Luke Cage and deal 1 damage to him → give him a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "He may have skin like steel, but he's got a heart of gold." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Mitigated Threat
cards.text:
Attach to a card. Attached card loses each ACCELERATION, AMPLIFY, CRISIS, and HAZARD icon.
Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.

cards.name: Piecing It All Together
cards.text:
This scheme does not count against the player side scheme limit.
When Defeated: The defeating player draws 3 cards.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, you take a step back to look at the big picture and it all falls into place.

cards.name: Reluctant Flier
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take at least 3 damage from an attack, discard this card → prevent all of that attack's damage. Take 1 damage.
cards.flavor: "I think I'm gonna puke." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Run Them to Ground
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Resolve each of the following:
• Skip the next villain phase.
• Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (immediately).
• The villain cannot take damage until the start of the next (unskipped) villain phase.

cards.name: Second Chance
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player may shuffle all of their identity-specific cards from their discard pile into their deck.
cards.flavor: "Let's do what heroes do best: save the day!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.
cards.flavor: "I'm not your bro." —Jessica Jones

cards.name: Snooping Around
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme and place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations. Discard the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a minion or side scheme, reveal it.

cards.name: Spider-Woman
cards.text: Response: After a character you control thwarts, place 1 limb counter here (to a maximum of 8). You may discard Spider-Woman to deal 1 damage to an enemy for each limb counter here.

cards.name: Squirrel Girl
cards.text:
Response: After you play Squirrel Girl from your hand, place 1 squirrel counter here for each card in your hand (to a maximum of 4).
Action: Remove 1 squirrel counter from here → remove 1 threat from a scheme.

cards.name: Stakeout
cards.text:
Action: If this card is in your play area, attach it to a non-permanent encounter side scheme.
Interrupt: When a character thwarts attached scheme, that thwart removes 2 additional threat. If that thwart defeats attached scheme, place 2 evidence counters on Alias Investigations.

cards.name: Strategy Session
cards.text:
Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player to search their deck for a player side scheme and add it to their hand.
Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a player side scheme.
cards.flavor: "Okay, gang, I've got a plan." —Nova

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.text:
Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.

cards.name: Blinding Flash
cards.text: Hero Action: Choose X enemies, where X is the number of different resource types (ENERGY, MENTAL, PHYSICAL, and WILD) used to pay for this event. Stun and confuse each chosen enemy.

cards.name: Cell Phone
cards.text:
Uses (3 charge counters).
Action: Exhaust Cell Phone, remove 1 charge counter from here, and choose a player → that player makes a basic attack or thwart with a character they control. That character gets +1 THW and +1 ATK for this use.

cards.name: Chamber
cards.text: STAR Chamber takes -1 consequential damage (COST) after he attacks a confused enemy.
cards.flavor: "Don't worry about me, luv — I've got this."

cards.name: Disguise
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Action (thwart): Exhaust Disguise and your identity → remove 2 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "The name's 'Patch.' Just 'Patch.'" —Wolverine

cards.name: Firecracker
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using 2 different resource types, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Where do they find all these henchmen? Must be a discount store somewhere." —Jubilee

cards.name: Flash of Light
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this card using 2 different resource types, confuse an enemy.
cards.flavor: "That's enough for me, folks. I'm out!" —Jubilee

cards.name: Generation X
cards.text:
Victory 0.
Each [[X-Men]] character gets +1 THW while making a basic thwart against this scheme.
When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for an identity-specific event and add it to their hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Grande Finale
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy. For each different resource type (ENERGY, MENTAL, PHYSICAL, and WILD) you used to pay for this card, choose an enemy and deal 2 damage to it.

cards.name: Husk
cards.text:
STAR Interrupt: When Husk uses a basic power, spend up to 3 resources → if you spent at least 1:
ENERGY — Husk gets +1 to that power for this use.
MENTAL — Heal 1 damage from Husk.
PHYSICAL — Ready Husk after this use.

cards.name: Jubilation Lee
cards.text: Mall Rat — Action: Search your deck for the Shopping Spree player side scheme and put it into play. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "This place was sooo much cooler when I lived here!"

cards.name: Jubilee
cards.text: "Like, totally!" — Resource: Exhaust Jubilee → generate a WILD resource.
cards.flavor: "You should know I get torqued when people ignore me!"

cards.name: Jubilee's Coat
cards.text:
Jubilee gets +1 THW.
Hero Response (thwart): After you play a [[Thwart]] event, exhaust Jubilee's Coat and choose a scheme → remove 1 threat from that scheme for each different resource type used to pay for that event.

cards.name: Jubilee's Sunglasses
cards.text:
Jubilee gets +1 ATK.
Hero Response (attack): After you play an [[Attack]] event, exhaust Jubilee's Sunglasses and choose an enemy → deal 1 damage to that enemy for each different resource type used to pay for that event.

cards.name: Multitalented
cards.text:
Hero Action (attack/thwart): If you paid for this event using at least 1:
PHYSICAL — Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
MENTAL — Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
ENERGY — Heal 2 damage from your identity.

cards.name: Mutant Mayhem
cards.text:
Alliance.
Hero Action: Choose an [[X-Force]] ally and an [[X-Men]] ally and return them to their owners' hands → those players play those allies, ignoring their resource costs.

cards.name: Serve and Protect
cards.text:
Alliance.
Hero Interrupt: When any amount of threat would be placed on the main scheme, exhaust an [[X-Force]] character and an [[X-Men]] character → prevent that threat and give each of those characters a tough status card.

cards.name: Shopping Spree
cards.text:
Threat cannot be removed from this scheme by heroes or allies.
Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your identity → remove 1 threat from here. Any player may trigger this ability.
When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme searches their deck and discard pile for an [[Item]] card and puts it into play.

cards.name: Synch
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait.
Interrupt: When you use a basic power, exhaust Synch → you get +1 to that power for this use.

cards.name: Three Steps Ahead
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): For each different resource type (ENERGY, MENTAL, PHYSICAL, and WILD) you used to pay for this card, choose a scheme and remove 2 threat from it.
cards.flavor: "You should be proud, Rogue—me and Glob worked this out ahead of time!" —Anole

cards.name: Unlikely Duo
cards.text:
Team-Up (Jubilee and Wolverine). Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action (attack): Confuse an enemy. Deal 4 damage to a confused enemy.

cards.name: Waylay
cards.text: Hero Response (attack): After your hero thwarts, deal 4 damage to an enemy (7 damage instead if that thwart removed the last threat from a scheme).
cards.flavor: "You hurt self-friends! No you will pay!" —Warlock

cards.name: Wolverine
cards.text:
STAR Wolverine's attacks gain piercing.
Response: After you change to alter-ego form, heal 3 damage from Wolverine.
cards.flavor: "Pipe down, squirt. We ain't here on holiday!"

cards.name: X-Gene
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[MUTANT]] trait. Max 1 per player
Resource: Exhaust X-Gene → generate a WILD resource for an identity-specific event.

cards.name: "Stand with Me!"
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Give Luke Cage a tough status card. Remove 1 threat from a scheme for each tough status card on Luke Cage (to a maximum of 5).
cards.flavor: "This is the greatest city in the world. I will not allow it to fall into chaos." —Luke Cage

cards.name: "Sweet Christmas!"
cards.text:
STAR Reduce the cost to play this card by 1 for each tough status card on Luke Cage.
Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to the villain and each minion engaged with you.

cards.name: Black Belt
cards.text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.

cards.name: Burstein Process
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Burstein Process → give Luke Cage a tough status card (2 tough status cards instead if he has none).
cards.flavor: "I got skin like steel and muscles to match." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
cards.text:
Attach to a minion. Max 1 per minion.
Attacks against attached minion deal 2 additional damage and gain overkill.
Response: After you play this card, engage attached minion.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.text:
Uses (3 block counters).
Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.

cards.name: Dynamic Duo
cards.text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Fogwell's Gym
cards.text: Response: After a tough status card is discarded from a [[Defender]] character, exhaust Fogwell's gym → ready that character.
cards.flavor: "Busted a lot of punching bags at this old place, and they never kicked me out." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Harlem's Hero
cards.text: Hero Action: Give Luke Cage a tough status card. For each tough status card on Luke Cage, choose a character you control and ready it.
cards.flavor: "It ain't just me. I've got family to back me up." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Hulk
cards.text:
Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here.
Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.

cards.name: Innovation
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.

cards.name: Iron Fist
cards.text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.
cards.flavor: "I've forgotten more about fighting than you'll ever know." —Iron Fist

cards.name: Jessica Jones
cards.text: STAR Jessica Jones gets +1 THW for each tough status card on your identity (to a maximum of +4 THW).
cards.flavor: "I'm here, and I'm not going anywhere."

cards.name: Knuckle Sandwich
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may discard a tough status card from Luke Cage to return this event to your hand.

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text:
Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing.
Forced Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, he takes 1 unpreventable damage (ignoring tough).

cards.name: Luke Cage
cards.text:
Unbreakable Skin — Luke Cage can have any number of tough status cards. Attacks against Luke Cage lose piercing.
Action: Search your deck and discard pile for the Burstein Process upgrade and add it to your hand. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Metal Bracer
cards.text:
Luke Cage gets retaliate 1.
Hero Interrupt: When any amount of damage would be dealt to Luke Cage, exhaust Metal Bracer → reduce that damage by 1.

cards.name: Misty Knight
cards.text:
Toughness.
STAR Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Come on, heroes. We've got to help save this city."

cards.name: Observe
cards.text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "There are other ways to see." —Daredevil

cards.name: Power Man
cards.text: Hero Response: After a tough status card is discarded from Luke Cage, exhaust Power Man → draw a card.
cards.flavor: "Tremble before the power of Power Man! That sounded weird. Luke Cage. Tremble before Luke Cage." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Righteous Purpose
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.
cards.flavor: "No more running." —Daredevil

cards.name: She-Hulk
cards.text:
Toughness.
Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "You interrupted my workout."

cards.name: Size Advantage
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).
cards.flavor: "Puny runt!" —Hulk

cards.name: Take a Stand
cards.text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.
cards.flavor: "It takes a lot more than that to keep me down." —Luke Cage

cards.name: Toughen Up
cards.text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Valkyrie
cards.text:
Toughness.
Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.

cards.name: "You Got This!"
cards.text: Hero Response: After you exhaust your hero to make a basic thwart or attack, discard an ally you control → add that ally's matching power to your hero's power for this use. Ready your hero.

cards.name: Anole
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Anole gets +1 THW and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "It's hard to be a kid when you look like a monster."

cards.name: Asteroid M
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Asteroid M → shuffle the topmost [[Magnetic]] card in your discard pile into your deck and heal 1 damage from your identity.
cards.flavor: "It took considerable effort to rebuild my home. Let's not destroy it again." —Magneto

cards.name: Bling!
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Bling! gains toughness and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "This school sucks!"

cards.name: Children of the Atom
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each [[X-Factor]], [[X-Force]], and [[X-Men]] character you control gains the [[X-Factor]], [[X-Force]], and [[X-Men]] traits.

cards.name: Cyclops
cards.text: Response: After Cyclops enters play, choose an enemy. Until the end of the phase, increase the amount of damage that enemy takes from each attack by 1.
cards.flavor: "To me, my X-Men!"

cards.name: Electromagnetic Blast
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. If this removes the last threat from that scheme, you may discard an attachment with the text "Hero Action" or "Hero Response."

cards.name: Erik Lehnsherr
cards.text: Survivor — Response: After you change to this form, shuffle the top 3 cards of your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "All that I've endured, and everything I've done, it was all to preserve mutantkind."

cards.name: Face the Past
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Hero Action: Search the encounter deck, discard pile, and set-aside area for your nemesis minion and reveal it → ready your hero and draw 3 cards. You cannot attack the villain this phase. Remove this card from the game.

cards.name: Indra
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Indra gets +2 hit points and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "I have seen atrocities done to mutants. No more!"

cards.name: Kid Omega
cards.text:
Response: After Kid Omega enters play, choose:
• Spend a ENERGY resource → deal 1 damage to each enemy.
• Spend a MENTAL resource → remove 1 threat from each scheme.

cards.name: M
cards.text: Response: After M enters play, defeat a minion with fewer remaining hit points than M.
cards.flavor: "I don't mind being a bull in a china shop."

cards.name: Magnetic Bubble
cards.text:
Magneto gains retaliate 1.
Forced Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, place it here. Then, if there is at least 6 damage here, discard Magnetic Bubble.

cards.name: Magnetic Missile
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard a minion with Wrapped in Metal attached → deal 5 damage to an enemy and stun it.
cards.flavor: "I have heard your threats, and here is my reply."—Magneto

cards.name: Magneto
cards.text: Magnetic Pull — Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until a [[Magnetic]] card is discarded → add that card to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I do not need to defend my decisions."

cards.name: Magneto's Armor
cards.text:
Response: After you resolve your "Magnetic Pull" ability, if you discarded at least 1 of the following resource icons:
MENTAL — Magneto gets +1 THW this round.
PHYSICAL — Magneto gets +1 ATK this round.
ENERGY — Magneto gets +1 DEF this round.

cards.name: Magneto's Cape
cards.text:
Magneto gains the [[Aerial]] trait.
Response: After you resolve your "Magnetic Pull" ability, exhaust Magneto's Cape → ready Magneto.

cards.name: Magneto's Helmet
cards.text:
Magneto gains steady.
Resource: Exhaust Magneto's Helmet → generate a WILD resource for a [[Magnetic]] card.
cards.flavor: Magneto's helmet protects him from telepathic attacks.

cards.name: Metal Shards
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If this attack defeats that enemy, gain a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "The way to defend mutants is to defeat our enemies." —Magneto

cards.name: New Recruits
cards.text:
Victory 0.
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Men]] trait.
When Defeated: Each player chooses 1 set-aside [[New]] ally and adds it to their hand.
cards.flavor: The dream of every student at Xavier's school is to join the X-Men.

cards.name: Noble Sacrifice
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard an ally you control → heal damage from your hero equal to that ally's printed hit points and give your hero a tough status card.
cards.flavor: "Don't wait for me. Go!" —X-23

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.text: Response: After Phoenix enters play, choose an [[X-Men]] ally → ready that ally and heal 1 damage from it.
cards.flavor: "Joining the X-Men means joining a family. It means you're never truly alone."

cards.name: Squared Off
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until you discard a minion. Put that minion into play engaged with you → play an ally from your hand, reducing its cost by 3.
cards.flavor: "Let's do this." —M

cards.name: Surge
cards.text:
Linked (New Recruits).
If you have the [[Mutant]] or [[X-Men]] trait, Surge gets +1 ATK and does not count against your ally limit.
cards.flavor: "Touch my friends and you get 10,000 volts!"

cards.name: White Queen
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait.
Response: After White Queen enters play, discard a status card from a character.
cards.flavor: "Oh darling, I hardly need psionic powers to manipulate you."

cards.name: Won't Stay Down
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] trait. Max 1 per player.
Alter-Ego Action: Discard this card → return an [[X-Force]] or [[X-Men]] ally from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Wrapped in Metal
cards.text:
Hero form only. Attach to a non-[[ELITE]] minion.
Attached minion cannot activate. Treat its printed text box as if it were blank.
cards.flavor: "Your power is no match for the Master of Magnetism!"—Magneto

cards.name: Aamir Khan
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Aamir Khan → place 1 card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck, then draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Are you okay? I mean, aside from being in the worst trouble of your life?"

cards.name: Big Hands
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "This hand thing... is getting out of hand..." —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Biokinetic Polymer Suit
cards.text: Hero Resource: Exhaust Biokinetic Polymer Suit → generate a WILD resource for an event.
cards.flavor: "What about that polymer you were working on for the scholarship? The super snot?" —Kamala Khan

cards.name: Bruno Carrelli
cards.text:
Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Bruno Carrelli → attach 1 card from your hand facedown here.
Action: Exhaust Bruno Carrelli → add up to 3 cards attached here to your hand.

cards.name: Concussive Blow
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Confuse an enemy. If you paid for this card using a PHYSICAL resource, deal 3 damage to that enemy.

cards.name: Down Time
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Your alter-ego gets +2 REC.
cards.flavor: "We should do this more often."

cards.name: Embiggen!
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you play an [[Attack]] event, exhaust Embiggen! → increase the amount of damage that event deals by 2.
cards.flavor: "EMBIGGEN!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Endurance
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
You get +3 hit points.

cards.name: Energy Barrier
cards.text: Uses (3 reflection counters). Interrupt: When you would take any amount of damage, remove 1 reflection counter from here → prevent 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Kamala Khan
cards.text: Teen Spirit — Action: Discard cards from the top of your deck until you discard a Ms. Marvel card, then add that card to your hand. (Limit once per round.)
cards.flavor: "I want to be beautiful and awesome and butt-kicking and less complicated"

cards.name: Lockjaw
cards.text: You may play Lockjaw from your discard pile during your turn (paying his resource cost).
cards.flavor: "Uhhh... hold on, Bruno. I think my new dog just teleported into my room." —Kamala Khan

cards.name: Melee
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Deal 3 damage to another enemy.

cards.name: Ms. Marvel
cards.text: "Morphogenetics" — Response: After you play an [[Attack]], [[Thwart]], or [[Defense]] event, exhaust Ms. Marvel → return that event to your hand.
cards.flavor: "You can call me Ms. Marvel. And if you cooperate, I won't throw you again."

cards.name: Nakia Bahadir
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Nakia Bahadir → reduce the cost of the next card you play this phase by 1.
cards.flavor: "You're too sweet, squishy muffin. You give people way too much credit." —Nakia Bahadir

cards.name: Nova
cards.text: Interrupt: When an enemy initiates an attack against you, spend a ENERGY resource → deal 2 damage to that enemy.
cards.flavor: "I guess mom was wrong. All those years of playing video games did pay off!"

cards.name: Preemptive Strike
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a boost card is turned face up while the villain attacks, cancel all boost icons (BOOST) on that card. Then deal 1 damage to the villain for each boost icon cancelled this way.

cards.name: Red Dagger
cards.text: Interrupt: When Red Dagger is defeated, spend 2 resources of different types → deal 2 damage to an enemy and return Red Dagger to your hand.
cards.flavor: "Karachi is my home. I patrol these neighborhoods."

cards.name: Shrink
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you play a [[Thwart]] event, exhaust Shrink → increase the amount of threat that event removes by 2.
cards.flavor: "Shrink, shrink, shrink!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Sneak By
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme.
cards.flavor: "This is my whole life in one garbage metaphor." —Kamala Khan

cards.name: Wiggle Room
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 3 of that damage. Draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Since we're just getting to know each other, a little FYI: I don't like being taken by surprise!" —Ms. Marvel

cards.name: Adam Warlock
cards.text:
Battle Mage - Action: Discard 1 card from your hand. Limit once per phase. If that card is:
- Aggression - Deal 2 damage to an enemy.
- Justice - Remove 2 threat from a scheme.
- Protection - Heal 1 damage from an ally.
- Leadership - Give a hero +1 THW, +1 ATK and +1 DEF this round.

Avatar of Life - During deck-building, your deck must include an equal number of cards from all 4 aspects. You cannot include more than 1 copy of any non-Adam Warlock card.
Action: Discard a card from your hand → remove a status card from Adam Warlock.

cards.name: Band Together

cards.name: Black Swan
cards.text:
Toughness. Victory 2.

cards.flavor: "Everything dies."

cards.name: Blue Marvel

cards.flavor: "I do whatever is right, whenever it needs to be done, and I don't care what anyone thinks."

cards.name: Captain America
cards.text:
Toughness.
Reduce the cost to play Captain America by 1 for each [AVENGER] character you control.

cards.text: Retaliate 1. Toughness.

cards.name: Cosmo

cards.name: Defensive Protocols
cards.text:
Hinder 2PER HERO. Victory 2.

cards.name: Energy Duplication

cards.name: Eternity
cards.text:
Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking)

cards.flavor: "Though I hold life most dear, I will answer Loki for what he has done."

cards.name: Find the Norn Stones
cards.text:
Threat cannot be removed from this scheme unless Hela has the [[Wounded]] trait.
When Defeated: Each player puts a copy of the Norn Stone upgrade into play under their control on its setup side. Flip this card over.

cards.name: Gamma
cards.text:
Energy form. Permanent.

Hero Response: After you change to this form, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

cards.flavor: "I wouldn't make me angry either." —Spectrum

cards.name: Hack Sanctuary's Computer
cards.text:
Hinder 1PER HERO.

cards.flavor: In order to defeat Thanos, you must deactivate his ship's many defenses.

cards.name: Hogun
cards.text: STAR Hogun's attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: "Loki has gone too far this time. He must be ended."

cards.name: In-Betweener
cards.text:
Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking)
When Revealed: Deal 2 damage to the villain and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Jormungand
cards.text:

cards.flavor: "So I'm fighting a monster. Not the worst way for a teenage girl to spend her Friday evening."

cards.flavor: "I'll have my people contact your people."

cards.name: Gwen Stacy

cards.flavor: "Time for the drum solo!"

Surge.

cards.text:
Permanent.
Your identity gets +3 hit points.
Hero Interrupt: When your hero would take any amount of damage from an enemy attack, discard the top card of your deck → prevent 1 of that damage.

cards.name: Jefferson Davis
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust Jefferson Davis → remove 1 threat from the scheme with the least threat.
cards.flavor: "I'm not proud of my past, but I don't regret it either. It brought me where I am today."

cards.name: Jump Flip
cards.text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage, prevent 2 of that damage. If you paid for this card using a ENERGY resource, remove 2 threat from the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "Up high! Down low! Aww, too slow."-Ghost-Spider

cards.name: Laser Goggles

cards.name: Miles Morales
cards.text: Response: After you change to this form, shuffle 1 Spider-Man card from your discard pile into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Once you've leaped from skyscrapers and fought off bad guys, everything else is a chore."

cards.name: Monica Chang
cards.text: Response: After Monica Chang enters play, search your deck, hand and discard pile for a copy of Surveillance Team support and put it into play. Place 1 snoop counter on each Surveillance Team you control.

Surge.
Victory 1. (When defeated, add this to the victory display.)

cards.name: Parental Guidance
cards.text:
Alter-Ego Action:
- If George Stacy is in play, attach 1 event from your hand or discard pile facedown to George Stacy.
- If George Stacy is not in play, search your deck and discard pile for him and add him to your hand. (Shuffle.)

cards.name: Phantom Flip
cards.text: Hero Response (thwart): After Ghost-Spider uses a basic power, remove 5 threat from a scheme. (Max 1 per basic power use.)
cards.flavor: "Life is most in-focus when the world is upside down."-Gwen Stacy

cards.name: Plan B
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Hero Action: Exhaust Plan B and discard 1 random card from your hand → deal 2 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Power Within
cards.text: Hero Response: After your hero uses a basic power, discard Power Within → resolve Spider-Man's "Venom Blast" ability.

cards.name: Propulsion Gauntlet

cards.text:
Permanent.
Hero Action: Exhaust Propulsion Gauntlet and take 2 indirect damage → ready your hero. Your hero gets +1 THW, +1 ATK, and +1 DEF until the end of the phase.

Standard Mode Only.
Victory 1. Uses (2PER HERO notoriety counters).

Response: After a minion or side scheme is defeated, remove 1 notoriety counter from here.

Your hero's basic thwart power (THW) can only remove threat from the scheme with the most threat.

Permanent.

Surge.
Victory 1. (When defeated, add this to the victory display.)

Permanent.

cards.name: Silk
cards.text: Response: After you play Silk from your hand, if you control another [[Web-Warrior]] card, search the encounter deck for a treachery and discard it. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: "Maybe I am getting the hang of this superhero stuff."

cards.name: Smear Campaign
cards.text:
In expert mode, this card gains surge.
When Revealed: If Public Outcry is in play, place 2 notoriety counters on it, then remove this card from the game. If Public Outcry is not in play, place 2 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Snitches Get Stitches
cards.text:
Victory -1.
Attach to Venom (Eddie Brock). If you cannot this card gains surge.

Action: Exhaust Venom and spend 2 resources of the same type → discard this card.

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text:
Venom Blast - Special: Deal 2 damage to an enemy. Stun that enemy.

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text:
Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card.

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Response: After you play Spider-Man from your hand, stun and confuse an enemy if you control at least 3 [[Web-Warrior]] cards.
cards.flavor: "Brooklyn doesn't like being run. We're wild like that."

cards.name: Spider-UK
cards.text: Interrupt: When Spider-UK defends against an attack, deal damage to the attacking enemy equal to the number of [[Web-Warrior]] cards you control.
cards.flavor: "People need protection and help, and we're the only ones who can do it."

cards.name: Spider-Woman
cards.text: Reduce the cost to play Spider-Woman by 1 for each confused enemy in play.
cards.flavor: "You're the A-team? Really? How far down the list do you think they were when they settled on you guys?"

cards.name: Swing In
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 4 threat from a scheme. If you paid for this card using a MENTAL resource, resolve Spider-Man's "Spider Camouflage" ability.
cards.flavor: "I can see that you're not happy to see me... or not see me?" —Spider-Man

cards.name: Symbiote Suit
cards.text:
Max 1 per deck.
Your identity gets +1 to each of its basic powers, +1 hand size, and +10 hit points.

cards.name: Venom

Ignore this card's resource cost if your identity has the [[Web-Warrior]] trait.

cards.text: Hero Response: After you resolve an "Interrupt" or "Response" ability on an event, exhaust Web-Bracelet → draw 1 card. (Max 1 per event.)
cards.flavor: "These should come in handy."-Gwen Stacy

cards.name: Web-Shot
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 4 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a ENERGY resource, resolve Spider-Man's "Venom Blast" ability.
cards.flavor: "If that doesn't hold you, I know something that will." —Spider-Man

cards.name: What Doesn't Kill Me
cards.text:
Requirement (PHYSICAL) (While paying for this card, spend the listed resources.)
Hero Action: Heal 2 damage from your hero → ready your hero.

Team-Up (Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales). Max 1 per deck.

cards.name: Ejection Protocol

cards.text:

cards.name: Host Spider

cards.name: Peni Parker
cards.text:
Psychogenetic Compatibility — Setup: Put SP//dr Suit into play, [[Inactive]] side faceup.
Maintenance — Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust SP//dr Suit → draw 2 cards.

Permanent. This card's printed text box cannot be treated as if it were blank.

Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card.

X is equal to the number of facedown cards attached to Spider-Man Noir.

Play only if your identity has at least 14 printed hit points.

cards.flavor: "Progress takes patience. That's why we have to keep working on it." —Aunt May

cards.name: Web-Trap
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 5 damage to an enemy. If you paid for this card using a resource generated by SP//dr Suit's "Sync Ratio" ability, stun that enemy.
cards.flavor: "May wanted SP//dr to be better, to be the best we could. That's why she developed these web-traps!"

cards.name: "I Don't Think So!"

cards.flavor: "I fight in purr-suit of justice and freedom!"

cards.name: Cartoon Physics

Spider-Ham gets +1 ATK.

cards.flavor: "Let no one cage you."

cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When your hero makes a basic thwart, it gets +2 THW for that thwart. After that thwart ends, if your hero removed all threat from a scheme that way, heal 2 damage from your hero.

cards.text:
Spider-Ham gets +1 THW.
Hero Action: Exhaust Organic Webbing and remove 1 toon counter from Spider-Ham → ready Spider-Ham. He gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Peter Porker
cards.text: Cartoon Power — Response: After you make a basic recovery, place 1 toon counter on Peter Porker.
cards.flavor: "You ever feel as if someone else is in control, like you're just a character in a game?"

cards.name: Petulant Pig
cards.text: Hero Action: Stick your tongue out at the villain. The villain attacks you. Draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "THBBPTHBPT!" —Spider-Ham

cards.name: SP//dr
cards.text:
Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card.

cards.text:
Play only if you control a [[Web-Warrior]] card.

cards.name: Spider-Ham
cards.text:
Each toon counter on Spider-Ham can be spent as if it were a WILD resource.
Spider-Nonsense — Response: After Spider-Ham takes any amount of damage, place 1 toon counter on him.

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Response: After Spider-Man enters play, remove 1 threat from a scheme for each [[Web-Warrior]] card you control (including Spider-Man).
cards.flavor: "Villains from Ham's future. Gigantic robots now. Worlds in the Web are becoming entangled."

cards.name: Swinging Web Pig
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 6 damage to an enemy. Confuse that enemy.
cards.flavor: "Am I a pig with the proportionate strength and agility of a spider? Or a spider with the physical limitations of a pig?" —Peter Porker

cards.name: The Daily Beagle
cards.text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust The Daily Beagle → place 1 toon counter on Peter Porker.
cards.flavor: "J. Jonah Jackal here with today's trusted, trademarked televised tirade—a tantrum tinged by a towering 'told you!'" —J. Jonah Jackal

Attached character gains the [[Web-Warrior]] trait.
Response: After a [[Web-Warrior]] ally leaves play, attached character gets +1 ATK until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Agile Flight
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [AERIAL] trait.
Hero Action (thwart): Remove a total of up to 5 threat from among schemes (as you choose).

cards.text: Hero Action: Choose up to X enemies, where X is equal to the number of [AERIAL] characters you control → deal 3 damage to each chosen enemy.

cards.name: Bad Boy
cards.text: Hero Interrupt When you would take any amount of damage from the villain's attack, discard this card → prevent all of that damage. Change to alter-ego form and draw 2 cards.
cards.flavor: "Ridin' in style!" —Peter Quill

cards.name: Beta Ray Bill
cards.text: Response: After Beta Ray Bill attacks and defeats a minion, remove 2 threat from the main scheme.
cards.flavor: "I may not be a native son of the realm eternal, but the power in my hammer comes from Odin himself. So I fight for Asgard, on this day and all tomorrows!"

cards.name: Blaze of Glory
cards.text:
Max 1 per round.

cards.name: C.I.T.T.
cards.text: Hero Action: Exhaust C.I.T.T. and spend 2 resources of any type → ready a [GUARDIAN] character.
cards.flavor: "I don't know, I kind of like calling it the Cool Interstellar Travel Travelship." —Peter Quill

cards.name: Daring Escape
cards.text: Hero Action Deal yourself 1 facedown encounter card → ready your hero and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "Okay, not to brag, but that was probably the bravest thing that any one of us has ever done." —Star-Lord

cards.name: Dive Bomb
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [AERIAL] trait.
Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 damage to each other enemy.

cards.name: Element Gun
cards.text:
Restricted.
Hero Action (attack): Exhaust Element Gun and spend 1 resource of any type → deal 3 damage to an enemy. This attack gains piercing.

cards.name: Gutsy Move
cards.text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. Remove 2 additional threat from that scheme for each facedown encounter card in front of you.

Star-Lord gains the [AERIAL] trait.
Hero Interrupt: When Star-Lord would take any amount of damage, exhaust Jet Boots → prevent 1 of that damage for each facedown encounter card in front of you.

cards.name: Laser Blaster

Attach to a [GUARDIAN] ally. Max 1 per ally.

cards.flavor: "I'll make short work of you." —Nebula

cards.text: Each [GUARDIAN] character you control gets +1 THW.
cards.flavor: "I know we all hate each other and we all tried to kill one another. But from now on, and until the job is done, we're Guardians." —Peter Quill

cards.name: Nova Prime
cards.text: Response: After you play Nova Prime from your hand, defeat a non-[ELITE] minion.
cards.flavor: "This is for Nova Corps!" —Nova Prime

cards.name: Peter Quill
cards.text:

Play only if you control an Element Gun.

cards.flavor: "You can't see that I'm judging you, but I'm judging you." —Star-Lord

cards.flavor: "Man, too easy." —Star-Lord

cards.name: Yondu

cards.flavor: "Don't need no one. I do what I want, when I want, how I want." —Yondu

Permanent.

cards.name: Clear Skies
cards.text:
Permanent.
Each character gains stalwart.

cards.flavor: "G.I.R.L. is dedicated to finding brilliant women who will not only save the world, but change it."

cards.name: Pinpoint Strike
cards.text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 7 damage to an enemy. If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, this attack deals 1 additional damage to that enemy and gains overkill.
cards.flavor: "You're going to want to ice that in the morning." —Wasp

cards.name: Rapid Growth
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When you use one of your hero's basic powers (THW, ATK, or DEF), change to your [[Giant]] hero form and get +2 to that power for this use.
cards.flavor: "Bet you didn't expect to see that." —Wasp

cards.name: Red Room Training
cards.text:
While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, you gain retaliate 1.
While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, your basic attacks gain piercing. (Discard any tough status cards from the target before dealing damage.)

cards.name: Running Interference
cards.text:
Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait.
Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from the main scheme. Remove X additional threat from the main scheme (to a maximum of 3), where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

cards.name: Spider-Man
cards.text: Response: After you play Spider-Man from your hand, choose THW or ATK. Spider-Man gets +2 to the chosen power until the end of the phase.
cards.flavor: "I'm needed. And just like that, none of the rest of it matters."

cards.name: Surprise Attack
cards.text: Hero Response (attack): After you change form, deal 3 damage to an enemy (4 damage instead if you paid for this card using PHYSICAL resource).

cards.name: Thor
cards.text: Response: After you play Thor from your hand, deal 2 damage to the villain (3 damage instead if you paid for this card using a PHYSICAL resource).
cards.flavor: "You wanna eat my hammer? Then by all means, take a big bite!"

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text:
Wasp gets +1 hit point for each pym counter on her.
Interrupt: When Wasp enters play, place 1 pym counter on her (to a maximum of 3) for each ENERGY resource you overpaid for Wasp's cost.

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text: Small but Mighty — Response: After Wasp (or an event you play) defeats a minion or side scheme, deal 1 damage to the villain.
cards.flavor: "You should learn to play nice!"

cards.name: Wasp
cards.text:
STAR Threat you remove using your basic thwart power (THW) can be divided among schemes as you choose.
STAR Damage you deal using your basic attack power (ATK) can be divided among enemies as you choose.
cards.flavor: "Aww, you're all so tiny and cute."

cards.name: Wasp Sting
cards.text:
Hero Action (attack): If you are in [[Giant]] hero form, deal a total of 4 damage divided among enemies you choose.
Hero Action (attack): If you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, deal 5 damage to an enemy.

cards.name: Wasp's Helmet
cards.text:
While you are in [[Giant]] hero form, you get +1 THW.
While you are in [[Tiny]] hero form, you get +1 ATK.

cards.name: "Now I'm Mad"
cards.text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
While your hero's remaining hit points are less than half your hero's starting hit points, your hero gets +1 ATK and -1 THW.

cards.name: Adamantium Lacing
cards.text:
You get +2 hit points.
X-23 gains retaliate 1 and her basic attacks gain piercing.
cards.flavor: X-23's claws are coated with the metal adamantium, making them incredibly sharp and nearly indestructible.

cards.name: Animal Instinct
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When X-23 makes a basic thwart, she gets +X THW for this thwart, where X is equal to her ATK.
cards.flavor: X-23 inherited Wolverine's superhuman senses...as well as his charming personality.

cards.name: Anticipated Attack
cards.text:
Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display.
Hero Interrupt (defense): When an enemy initiates an attack, give your hero a tough status card.

cards.name: Boom Boom
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Boom Boom → add 1 boom counter to her. Then, you may discard Boom Boom to deal 1 damage to each enemy for each boom counter on her.
cards.flavor: "Tick...tick...tick..."

cards.name: Claw Mastery
cards.text:
Max 1 per round.
Hero Action: Until the end of the round, X-23 gets +2 ATK (and her attacks gain overkill while Honey Badger is in play).

cards.name: Combat Specialist
cards.text:
Linked (Specialized Training).
Your hero gets +1 ATK.
Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic attack, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Critical Hit
cards.text:
Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display.
Hero Response: After you attack an enemy, stun it.

cards.name: Defense Specialist
cards.text:
Linked (Specialized Training).
Your hero gets +1 DEF.
Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic defense, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Front Line Specialist
cards.text:
Linked (Specialized Training).
Your identity gets +4 hit points.
Response: After your identity takes damage from an enemy attack, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: Grim Resolve
cards.text: Resource: Exhaust this card and take 1 damage → generate a WILD resource.
cards.flavor: "Is that all you got?" —X-23

cards.name: Honey Badger
cards.text: Hero Response: After Honey Badger takes any amount of damage, ready X-23.
cards.flavor: "You don't scare me. And I won't let you mess with my friends anymore!"

cards.name: Keep Them Busy
cards.text:
Victory 0.
Assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.)
When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme removes 5PER HERO threat from the main scheme.

cards.name: Laura Kinney
cards.text:
Shhnk! — Setup: Put X-23's Claws into play.
Action: Shuffle either the Honey Badger ally or the Sisterly Bond event from your discard pile into your deck → draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)

cards.name: Pain Tolerance
cards.text: Response: After you play an X-23 card (including this one), heal 1 damage from your identity.
cards.flavor: "Barely felt a thing." —X-23

cards.name: Predictable Ploy
cards.text:
Play only if there is a side scheme in the victory display.
Hero Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel its "When Revealed" effects.

cards.name: Puncture Wound
cards.text:
Attach to an enemy that X-23 or Honey Badger attacked this turn.
Attached enemy gets -1 ATK.
Forced Response: After the player phase begins, discard this card and deal 3 damage to attached enemy.

cards.name: Rally the Troops
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Heal 2 damage from each ally.
cards.flavor: "Press on, team! Victory is in sight!" —Cyclops

cards.name: Regenerative Longevity
cards.text: Action: Heal a total of 4 damage from your identity and Honey Badger.
cards.flavor: "If what doesn't kill you makes you stronger, I should have Colossus-level strength by now." —X-23

cards.name: Rictor
cards.text: STAR Response: After Rictor attacks, discard the top card of your deck. Deal 1 damage to each minion engaged with you for each resource on the discarded card.

cards.name: Shatterstar
cards.text: STAR Interrupt: When Shatterstar attacks a minion, engage that minion. If you are already engaged with that minion, Shatterstar gets +1 ATK for this attack.
cards.flavor: A skilled swordfighter, Shatterstar can even cut openings in space to teleport vast distances.

cards.name: Sisterhood
cards.text: Action: Exhaust Sisterhood and discard an X-23 card from your hand → search your deck and discard pile for Honey Badger and add her to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.flavor: Laura and Gabby's bond is stronger than genetics.

cards.name: Sisterly Bond
cards.text: Hero Interrupt: When Honey Badger thwarts or attacks, add X-23's matching power to Honey Badger's power for this use.
cards.flavor: "High five!" —Honey Badger

cards.name: Specialized Training
cards.text:
Victory 0.
When Defeated: Each player who does not control a [[SPECIALIZATION]] upgrade chooses 1 set-aside [[SPECIALIZATION]] upgrade and puts it into play under their control.

cards.name: Surveillance Specialist
cards.text:
Linked (Specialized Training).
Your hero gets +1 THW.
Hero Response: After your hero performs a basic thwart, exhaust this card → draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Direct Approach
cards.text:
Attach to a non-permanent side scheme. Limit 1 per side scheme.
Attached scheme gains assault. (Basic thwarts against this scheme use ATK instead of THW.)

cards.name: X-23
cards.text: Living Weapon — Response: After X-23 takes any amount of damage, ready X-23. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "The Facility created me to kill, but I choose to fight to protect life."

cards.name: X-23's Claws
cards.text:
Permanent.
Hero Action: Exhaust X-23's Claws and take 2 damage → X-23 gets +2 ATK until the end of the round.
